pages.text: How to open the DashboardWhen you open Rivyo from your Shopify store, the Dashboard is the first page you see. It gives you a performance snapshot of your reviews, loyalty program, and referral program.1. Open your Shopify store. Go to your Shopify dashboard.2. Go to Apps. In the left sidebar, click Apps.3. Open Rivyo. Click Rivyo: Reviews & Loyalty.The Dashboard loads automatically.What you see on the DashboardPerformance OverviewThe top of the Dashboard shows a summary of activity for the last 30 days. You can change the date range using the date picker in the top-right corner of this section.Metric What it meansReviews Received Total number of reviews submitted to your store in the selected period.Published Reviews that are live and visible to shoppers on your store.Unpublished Reviews that have been received but are not yet live (pending your approval or auto-publish settings).Emails Sent Number of review request emails sent to customers in the selected period.Setup GuideIf you are new to Rivyo, a Setup Guide appears below the performance numbers. pages.title: Rivyo Product Reviews for Shopify – Overview & Features • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: What is Rivyo Product Reviews?OverviewRivyo Product Reviews & Q&A is a Shopify app that helps you collect, manage, and display customer reviews on your store.It also allows customers to ask questions about your products directly on your product pages.When shoppers see real feedback from real customers, they feel more confident buying. Rivyo helps you collect this feedback automatically so you can build trust and increase sales without any technical setup.What Rivyo lets you doRivyo gives you the tools to collect and manage customer feedback easily.Collect reviews automaticallyRivyo can send review request emails to customers after they receive their order.This helps you collect reviews without manually contacting customers.Display reviews on your storeYou can display reviews in different formats on your store, including:Star ratingsReview listsReview carouselsCustomer testimonialsThese can appear on product pages and other areas of your store.Manage incoming reviewsAll reviews can be managed from one place inside Rivyo.You can:Read customer reviewsApprove or hide reviewsReply to customer feedbackRemove reviews when necessaryThis helps you keep your reviews accurate and helpful for shoppers.Import existing reviewsIf you already have reviews, you can import them into Rivyo.Reviews can be imported from:CSV filesAliExpressAmazonOther review apps such as Judge.me, Loox, or YotpoThis allows you to keep your existing social proof when switching to Rivyo.Run product Q&ACustomers can ask questions directly on your product pages.You can reply to these questions publicly so other shoppers can see the answers. This helps customers make better buying decisions.Reward customers for leaving reviewsYou can automatically send discount coupons to customers who leave a review.This encourages more customers to share their feedback.Boost your store’s SEORivyo can connect your reviews with Google Shopping so your product star ratings may appear in search results.Star ratings in search results can improve visibility and help attract more customers to your store.Who is Rivyo for?Rivyo is designed for Shopify store owners who want to build trust and increase sales using customer reviews.You do not need any coding or technical knowledge to use Rivyo. The app is designed to be simple and easy to manage.Good to knowRivyo supports both product reviews and store reviews.Product reviews are linked to a specific product.Store reviews reflect the overall experience with your store.You can start collecting reviews within minutes after installing Rivyo.

pages.title: How Rivyo Collects Product Reviews on Shopify • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: OverviewRivyo helps you collect product and store reviews from real customers, using both automated and manual request methods. Once the app is installed, you can send review requests after an order is fulfilled/placed, share a direct review link anywhere, collect reviews with QR codes, and optionally reward customers for leaving feedback.Your customers leave reviews using Rivyo’s review form (rating + written feedback). Depending on your settings, they may also be able to add photos.Ways Rivyo collects reviewsRivyo includes several collection options, so you can choose what fits your store and customer journey.1) Automatic review request emails (post-purchase)Automatic requests are the “set it once” option. Rivyo emails customers after their order is fulfilled, asking them to review the item(s) they purchased.When it sends: after fulfillment, based on the delay you set (for example, a few days after delivery).What customers receive: an email with a button/link that opens the review form for the purchased product(s).Best for: consistent review collection without manual follow-up.In your Rivyo admin, go to the Automation (or Email Requests) section.Enable automatic requests, then set the sending delay (for example, “Send X days after fulfillment”).Review the email template (logo, colors, text) so it matches your store.Save changes. Rivyo will begin sending requests to eligible fulfilled orders going forward.If you sell items with longer delivery times, set a longer delay so customers have time to use the product before reviewing.2) Manual review requests (send to specific customers)Manual requests let you send a review request to a specific customer and/or for specific products—useful when you want to follow up personally or resend a request.Common use cases:You want a review from a particular customer (for example, VIPs or repeat buyers).You want to resend a request to someone who missed the first email.You want to request a review for an order that wasn’t included in automation.Open the Requests (or Manual Requests) area in Rivyo.Choose the customer (or enter their email) and select the product(s) you want reviewed.Send the request email. The customer receives a link to the review form for the selected items.Manual requests are best used selectively. For ongoing collection, automation is usually the most reliable approach.3) Shareable review links and QR codesReview links and QR codes give customers a direct path to the review form—no email automation required. This is especially useful for offline touchpoints and social messaging.You can share links/QR codes via:Email newsletters or order follow-upsSMS and messaging (for example, WhatsApp)Printed invoices, packing slips, and product insertsIn-store signage or event boothsIn Rivyo, open Review Links (or QR Code) and choose the product (or store review, if available).Copy the shareable link, or download the QR code image for printing.Add the link to digital channels, or print the QR code on inserts/receipts so customers can scan and review quickly.Place QR codes where customers naturally pause (packing slip footer, thank-you card, or a small insert). Add a short line like “Scan to leave a review” to increase scans.4) Review campaigns for past customers (bulk requests)If you installed Rivyo after you already had sales, campaigns help you catch up by sending a one-time request to customers from past orders.What it does: sends a review request email to a selected group of previous buyers.Best for: new Rivyo installs, seasonal resets, or collecting reviews for best-selling products.Go to Campaigns in your Rivyo admin.Select the order date range and customers/products you want to include.Confirm the email template and sending details.Send immediately or schedule it (if scheduling is available in your plan/settings).Avoid emailing very old orders where customers may not remember the purchase—this can reduce response rates and increase unsubscribes.5) Review rewards (incentives for leaving a review)Rewards encourage more customers to leave reviews by offering a thank-you incentive (for example, a discount coupon) after a review is submitted.Typical reward: an automatic discount coupon delivered after the customer submits a review.Best for: increasing review volume and improving response rates.Open the Rewards section in Rivyo and turn rewards on.Choose the coupon type/value and any limits (for example, one reward per customer, if available).Set how customers receive the reward (usually by email after submission).Save changes and run a quick test (for example, submit a test review) to confirm the reward is sent as expected.Make your reward message clear: “Thanks for your feedback—here’s X% off your next order.” Simple wording tends to perform best.Choosing the right methodUse Automatic review request emails. Set an appropriate delay after fulfillment and keep the template on-brand.Use Manual review requests to target the exact customer and products.Use Review links and QR codes. They work well outside email and are easy for customers to access on mobile.Use Review campaigns to send a one-time request to past customers.Enable Review rewards. Incentives can significantly improve response rates when used responsibly.

pages.title: Customize the Review Form in Rivyo | Shopify Product Reviews • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Review Form controls what customers see when they submit a product review on your store. By customizing the form, you can collect the feedback that matters most—without overwhelming customers with unnecessary fields. You can customize the form by: Enabling or disabling questions Making questions required or optional Reordering questions Adding custom questions Keep your form short. A simple form typically increases completion rates, while optional fields (like photos) help you gather richer reviews from customers who want to share more. Before you customize the review form Customers can only submit reviews on your storefront if your review widgets are installed and visible. Required widgets Product Review Widget — Displays reviews and the review submission form on product pages. All Product Reviews Widget — Shows all reviews from your store in one place (useful for a dedicated “Reviews” page). If you don’t see the review form on your product page, confirm the Product Review Widget is added to your theme and published. Default review questions Rivyo includes a set of default questions that can appear in your review form. Depending on your settings, these may include: Name Email Rating Review title Review (written text) Customer image Review image (photo upload) Recommendation checkbox Some fields can be required to ensure reviews contain enough information. You can enable/disable these fields and decide which ones must be completed before submission. Enable or disable questions Each question in the review form has a status toggle (for example, Enabled/Disabled). Use it to control whether the question appears to customers. Examples Enable Review image to encourage photo reviews. Enable Recommendation to capture “Yes/No” product recommendations. Disable fields you don’t need (for example, email) to reduce friction. Disabling too many fields can reduce review quality. Most stores keep Rating and at least one written field (like Review or Review title) enabled so reviews stay helpful. Make questions required or optional Some questions can be marked as Required. When a question is required, customers must complete it before they can submit their review. Common setup Rating is typically required. Review text is often required if you want detailed feedback. Images are usually optional (customers can add them when they want). If you require both a long written review and a photo, you may get fewer submissions. Consider keeping photos optional and using a post-purchase email to encourage photo uploads. Reorder questions Arrange questions in the order customers should answer them. A good order can improve completion rates and reduce confusion. Recommended order Rating Review title (optional) Review text Photos (optional) Recommendation checkbox (optional) Put your most important questions near the top of the form so customers see them first. Add a custom question Add your own question when you want feedback that’s specific to your products (for example, sizing, fit, durability, or delivery experience). Go to Collect Reviews → Review Form. Select Add Question. Enter an Internal Name. This is for your reference in the app (customers won’t typically see it), so use something clear like Size / Fit or How did it perform?. Enter the Question Text exactly as customers should see it (for example, “How was the fit?”). Select the Field Type that matches how customers should answer (for example, a short answer for quick feedback or a dropdown for consistent data). Select the products (or product groups, if available in your setup) where the question should be shown. Use this to keep questions relevant—for example, only show “How was the fit?” on apparel. Decide if the question should be Required, then Save. Preview the form on a product page to confirm the layout. Product-specific questions help you collect better insights without cluttering the form for every item in your catalog. Best practices for higher-quality reviews Ask one thing per question (avoid “What did you like and what would you change?” in a single field). Prefer structured answers (dropdowns/choices) when you want consistent reporting (for example, “True to size: Small / True / Large”). Use required fields sparingly—require only what you truly need. Keep optional photo uploads to encourage media without reducing submissions. Apparel: “How was the fit?” (Too small / True to size / Too large) Skincare: “What is your skin type?” (Dry / Oily / Combination / Sensitive) Electronics: “Was setup easy?” (Yes / No + optional details) Food: “How would you rate the flavor?” (1–5) or (Mild / Medium / Strong) The question is Disabled in your Review Form settings. The question is assigned to different products than the one you’re testing. The review widget isn’t published or isn’t placed on the product page. Your theme cache needs a refresh—try a hard refresh in your browser after saving changes.

pages.title: Review Requests in Rivyo – Collect Product Reviews Automatically • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Review Requests helps you collect product reviews by emailing customers after they buy from your store. Rivyo sends customers a link that opens your review form, where they can rate the product and share written feedback (and any other fields you’ve enabled). From the Review Requests page, you can automate review emails, send one-off requests, customize email templates, monitor delivery and review status, and run bulk campaigns for past orders. The best-performing review requests are sent soon after delivery (while the product is fresh in the customer’s mind) and include a friendly reminder email for customers who don’t respond to the first message. Where to find Review Requests Go to Apps in Shopify, then open Rivyo. In the Rivyo menu, select Review Requests. Screen labels may vary slightly depending on your Rivyo version, but the features below are all located within the Review Requests area. What you can do in Review Requests Review Requests includes five core tools. Use the sections below to choose the right workflow for your goal. Automatic Review Requests Automatic requests send review emails to customers without manual work—based on order events such as being placed or fulfilled. This is the most reliable way to collect reviews consistently. What you can control Send timing: how long after the order event the first email is sent. Reminders: whether to send follow-up emails if the customer hasn’t submitted a review. Recipients: which customers receive requests (for example, exclude certain orders if needed). Alerts: when review-related notifications are triggered (based on your app settings). In Review Requests, open Automatic Review Requests and enable sending. Choose the trigger (for example, after Order Fulfilled) and set the delay (for example, 7 days). Enable reminders and set the reminder schedule (for example, send 1 reminder after 3 days). Save your settings so new eligible orders start receiving review requests automatically. If your first email is scheduled too soon (for example, immediately after fulfillment), customers may receive the request before they’ve tried the product. This can reduce response rates and increase negative feedback. Manual Review Requests Manual requests let you send a review email to a specific customer and select the products you want them to review. This is useful when you need to follow up individually or when an order doesn’t fit your usual automation flow. When to use manual requests You want feedback from a particular customer (VIP, wholesale, support case follow-up). A customer purchased through a custom flow and didn’t receive an automatic request. You want to resend a request to the same customer. In Review Requests, open Manual Review Requests. Enter the customer’s email address and select the product(s) you want included in the request. Send the request. The customer receives an email with a link to your review form. If you manually send requests often for the same scenario, consider adjusting your automatic rules so those orders are covered going forward. Email Templates Email Templates control what customers see when Rivyo emails them. A clear subject line, friendly message, and a strong call-to-action can significantly improve review submission rates. Templates you can customize Primary review request email: the first message customers receive. Reminder email(s): follow-ups sent when no review has been submitted yet. In Review Requests, go to Email Templates. Update the subject line and body content, and ensure your store name and tone match your brand. Confirm the email includes the review button/link and any dynamic fields you use (such as customer or product details). Save the template, then send a test email (if available) to verify formatting on desktop and mobile. Keep the email short and focused: one clear request, one primary button (for example, “Leave a review”), and reassurance that it only takes a minute. Review Email Activity Review Email Activity helps you understand what happened after you sent review requests—so you can spot delivery problems, confirm coverage, and resend when appropriate. What you can track Sent emails: which review request messages were sent and when. Order coverage: which orders received a request. Review status: whether a review was submitted after the email was sent. Resends: resend review emails when needed (for example, customer says they didn’t see it). In Review Requests, select Review Email Activity. Use the list and any available filters/search to locate the relevant email or order. Review the status (sent/submitted) and resend if appropriate. Avoid repeatedly resending to the same customer within a short period. Too many emails can increase spam complaints and reduce deliverability for future requests. Review Campaigns (Past Orders) Review Campaigns let you send review requests in bulk to customers who purchased in the past. This is especially useful right after installing Rivyo—so you can start collecting reviews from recent buyers immediately, not just new orders going forward. What you can do with campaigns Select a date range of past orders. Send review requests in bulk to eligible customers. Collect reviews for older purchases to build social proof quickly. In Review Requests, go to Review Campaigns. Select the period you want to target (for example, the last 30 or 90 days). Confirm the number of orders/customers included, then send the campaign. Use Review Email Activity to track sending and submissions after the campaign. Campaign sends are bulk actions. Double-check your date range before sending to avoid emailing customers who purchased too long ago or who shouldn’t be contacted. Best practices for higher review rates Time it right: send after delivery/usage time (often 7–14 days depending on your products). Use one reminder: a single follow-up commonly boosts responses without feeling spammy. Keep templates simple: one clear call-to-action, minimal distractions. Segment thoughtfully: use campaigns for recent buyers first to maximize relevance. Watch Activity: if reviews are low, adjust timing and template messaging before increasing volume. FAQ Common reasons include: The order didn’t meet your automatic request rules (trigger, timing, or recipient conditions). The email was sent but the customer didn’t notice it (check Review Email Activity and resend if appropriate). The campaign/date range didn’t include that order. Start by confirming the order appears in Review Email Activity. If it doesn’t, use a Manual Review Request. Most stores get better results after fulfillment (or after delivery, if your workflow supports it) because customers have had time to use the product. Sending right after order placement can reduce response quality and increase “I haven’t received it yet” replies. Yes. Use Review Email Activity to find the original request and resend when needed, or send a Manual Review Request if you’re targeting a specific product or scenario. Learn how to write and brand your review request emails for higher conversions. Configure timing, reminders, and recipient rules for hands-free review collection. Send bulk requests to past customers to build social proof quickly.

pages.title: Configure Email Notifications for Reviews and Questions • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Email Notifications let Rivyo email your team as soon as customers submit: Product reviews Store reviews Product questions This helps you stay on top of new feedback and respond quickly when needed. Before you use Rivyo features that send emails (such as review request emails, review replies, and notification alerts), make sure Email Notification is enabled and your sender/recipient details are correct. Where to find these settings In your Shopify admin, go to: Rivyo → Settings → Email Notification Why email notification setup matters Correct configuration ensures that: You’re alerted immediately when customers leave reviews or ask questions. The right people on your team receive those alerts (support, CX, store manager, etc.). Notification emails display the correct sender name and email address for your brand. You avoid missed messages caused by typos, invalid addresses, or disabled notifications. Use a shared inbox (for example, [email protected]) and add additional recipients (such as your CX lead) so notifications are never missed when someone is out of office. Enable email notifications To start receiving notification emails, you must turn the setting on and save your changes. Go to Rivyo → Settings → Email Notification. In the Email Notification section, enable Enable Notification. Fill in Sender Name and Sender Email (details below). Enter the email address(es) that should receive notifications (details below). Click Save to apply your changes. Changes won’t take effect until you Save. If you navigate away without saving, notifications may remain disabled or use old email addresses. Configure sender information Sender information controls what your team sees in the “From” area of notification emails (and helps recipients recognize the message quickly). Sender Name This is the display name recipients will see as the sender. Examples Your Store Name Your Store Support Reviews Team Use your store name (or a consistent support label) so messages are easy to identify in a busy inbox. Sender Email This is the email address the notification appears to come from. Examples [email protected] [email protected] If you want to use a custom email address and it isn’t sending successfully, your domain may require additional setup. If you suspect this is happening, contact Rivyo support and share the email address you’re trying to use. Configure recipient emails Recipient Emails determines where Rivyo sends notification alerts. What recipients will receive When enabled, recipients can be notified about: A new product review A new store review A new product question Other review-related activity configured in your Rivyo notification settings How to enter recipient emails Add the email address for the main owner (for example, [email protected]). If the field supports multiple recipients, add additional addresses for anyone who needs alerts (for example, a CX manager or store manager). If you route customer messages through a helpdesk, consider using your helpdesk’s inbound address (for example, [email protected]) so notifications automatically become tickets. Recommended setup (best practices) Use a monitored inbox: Choose a recipient email that is checked daily. Keep sender identity consistent: Use one Sender Name/Email across your store communications when possible. Add backup recipients: If you rely on a single person, add a second recipient so nothing is missed. Review after changes: If you change your domain, support inbox, or team workflows, revisit these settings. Troubleshooting Confirm Enable Notification is turned on and you clicked Save. Double-check the Recipient Emails for typos (extra spaces, missing characters, wrong domain). Check your spam/junk folder and any email security/quarantine tools used by your domain. Make sure your mailbox isn’t full and can receive new messages. Submit a test review or question on your storefront to trigger a new notification. Use a professional sender address on your domain (for example, [email protected]). Add the sender address to your email client’s safe sender/allow list. If you use a custom sender email, your domain may require additional email authentication setup. Contact Rivyo support if deliverability is inconsistent. Update Recipient Emails to the correct inbox(es), then click Save. If multiple people need alerts, add all necessary recipients so messages don’t bottleneck with one person. Update Sender Name and Sender Email, then click Save. Use a sender identity that matches your brand (for example, “Your Store Support”). What’s next Configure automated or manual review requests so customers are invited to leave feedback after purchase. Learn how to reply to customer reviews directly and keep communication consistent. Manage customer questions and respond quickly to improve conversion and trust.

pages.title: Automatic Review Request Emails in Rivyo | Collect Reviews Automatically • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Automatic Review Requests let Rivyo email customers after they buy, so you can collect product reviews without sending requests manually. Once enabled, Rivyo sends a review request email based on your timing rules. Customers can open the email, click through, and submit feedback using the Rivyo review form. For the best review quality, start timing from Order fulfilled and send the first email after the customer has time to receive and use the product. Enable Automatic Review Requests In your Shopify admin, open Rivyo, then go to Collect Reviews → Review Requests. Open the Review Automation tab and enable Automatic Review Requests. Review your Timing, Audience, and Email controls (below). Rivyo will send emails using these rules going forward. Automatic Review Requests only send to customers who have a valid email address on the order. Automation and timing settings Timing settings control when Rivyo sends the first email and any reminders. Start timing from Order fulfilled (Recommended) — Sends requests after fulfillment, giving customers time to receive and try the product before reviewing. Order placed — Sends requests based on the order date, regardless of fulfillment status. If you sell items with longer delivery times or made-to-order products, starting from Order placed can send requests before the customer receives the item. Send first email Choose how long Rivyo waits before sending the first review request email. Example: Send the email 1 day after fulfillment. Use a longer delay for products that need time to experience (skincare, supplements, high-consideration items). Send reminder email Optionally send a reminder if the customer hasn’t submitted a review after the first email. Example: Send a reminder 2 days after the first email if no review is submitted. Reminders can increase review volume without requiring extra manual work. Keep reminders limited (for example, one reminder) and space them out. Too many emails can reduce engagement and increase unsubscribes. Audience rules (who receives emails) Audience rules help you control which customers are eligible to receive review request emails. Send to repeat customers only Enable this option if you only want review requests sent to customers who have purchased before. Set the minimum number of completed orders required before a customer receives review requests. This is helpful if you want reviews primarily from more engaged, returning customers. If you want to collect as many reviews as possible (especially for new stores or new product launches), leave this option disabled so first-time customers can review too. Review email controls (prevent unnecessary emails) These settings reduce duplicate requests and help ensure customers only receive relevant review emails. Stop sending requests if customer already reviewed When enabled, Rivyo will stop sending review request emails (including reminders) once the customer has submitted a review for the purchased product(s). This is recommended for most stores. It prevents customers who already reviewed from receiving follow-up reminders. How Rivyo decides whether to send a reminder If the customer submits a review after the first email, Rivyo does not send the reminder. If the customer does not submit a review within your reminder window, Rivyo sends the reminder (if enabled). Recommended setup (best-practice defaults) If you’re not sure where to start, these settings are a strong baseline for most Shopify stores: Start timing from: Order fulfilled First email: 7–14 days after fulfillment (shorter for fast-delivery items, longer for products that take time to use) Reminder: 3–7 days after the first email Stop sending if customer already reviewed: Enabled Repeat customers only: Disabled (enable only if you intentionally want to limit requests) FAQ Fulfillment usually aligns better with the customer’s real experience. It reduces the chance of requesting a review before the product arrives, which can lead to lower-quality reviews or lower response rates. Rivyo sends the first review request email based on your timing settings. If reminders are enabled, it may send a reminder only when the customer hasn’t submitted a review yet. If Stop sending requests if customer already reviewed is enabled, Rivyo will not continue emailing customers who already left a review. Reminders typically increase the number of reviews collected. A single reminder is a good balance for most stores—helpful without overwhelming customers. Use it if you want to limit review requests to customers with an established relationship with your brand (for example, to prioritize more informed reviews). If you are growing your store or launching new products, consider leaving it off to capture more reviews. Related Manage your review request settings and automation rules. Customize your review request email design and wording. Learn different ways to collect more reviews with Rivyo.

pages.title: Send Manual Review Requests in Rivyo | Request Product Reviews from Customers • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Manual Review Requests let you send a review request email to a specific customer, one at a time. This is useful when you don’t want to rely on your automatic review request settings (or when an automatic email wasn’t sent). With a manual request, you choose: Who receives the email (customer email address) What they’re asked to review (up to 5 products per email) Manual Review Requests are sent individually. They don’t change your automatic review request settings or schedule. When to use manual review requests Manual requests are especially helpful when: You want feedback from a specific customer (VIPs, repeat buyers, wholesale customers, etc.). A customer ordered before you enabled automatic review requests. An automatic review request didn’t send (for example, the order didn’t meet your automation rules). You want to resend a review request after a customer asked you to. If you’re trying to collect reviews at scale, use your automatic review requests for most orders and reserve manual requests for exceptions. How to send a manual review request In your Shopify admin, open Rivyo, then go to Collect Reviews → Review Requests. Open the Send Manual Requests tab. Customer Name (optional): Helps you identify requests later in your records. Customer Email Address: This is where the review request email will be sent. Click Add Product, then select the product(s) you want the customer to review. You can include up to 5 products in a single email. Click Send Review Request. The customer will receive an email inviting them to submit a review. Review requests won’t send to customers who have unsubscribed from review request emails (see Unsubscribed emails below). Request history Every manual review request you send appears in the Request History section. Use it to confirm what was sent and track outcomes over time. In Request History, you can see: Date sent Customer email address Submission status (whether a review was submitted) Filtering request history To quickly find a specific request, use Filter by email and enter the customer’s email address. This is useful when a customer asks, “Can you resend the review link?” or when you’re checking whether a request was already sent. Unsubscribed emails Customers can choose not to receive review request emails. You can view these addresses in the Unsubscribed Emails list. If an email address is on the unsubscribed list, Rivyo will not send review request emails to that customer. This applies to both manual requests and any other review request emails that use the same opt-out list. If a customer says they’re not receiving review requests, check the Unsubscribed Emails list first before resending. Best practices (to get more reviews) Send at the right time: Request a review after the order is likely delivered and the customer has had time to use the product. Ask the right customers: Only send requests to customers who purchased (or received) the product you select. Keep it focused: Include only the most relevant products—avoid adding 5 items unless the customer genuinely bought multiple products and would reasonably review them. Don’t over-send: Repeated requests can annoy customers and reduce response rates. Resend only when it’s justified (for example, customer asked for it). Personalize with care: If you use the optional customer name, ensure it’s accurate—incorrect names can reduce trust. If you’re resending a request, space it out and keep it to one follow-up. Many stores see better results with one gentle reminder rather than multiple repeats. FAQ You can include up to 5 products in one manual review request email. No. Manual review requests are sent individually and don’t change your automatic review request configuration. The most common reason is that the customer’s email is in the Unsubscribed Emails list. Customers who opted out won’t receive review request emails. Yes. Check Request History to see the request details and whether a review was submitted.

pages.title: Customize Review Request Email Templates in Rivyo • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Email Templates section lets you customize the review request emails that Rivyo sends to your customers after a purchase. These emails invite customers to rate the products they bought and share feedback—so keeping the message clear, on-brand, and easy to act on can significantly improve your review rate. You can update the subject line, message content, and the look and feel (logo/header, colors, layout) to match your store branding. Keep the email short and focused: remind customers what they purchased, set expectations (“takes 30 seconds”), and include one clear call-to-action to leave a review. Available email templates Rivyo includes two types of review request emails. You can customize each template separately. Primary Review Request This email is automatically sent based on your automation settings (for example, after an order is placed or fulfilled). It asks customers to review the products they purchased. Reminder Email The reminder email is sent only if the customer hasn’t submitted a review after receiving the first email. Reminders often increase the total number of reviews you collect—without needing manual follow-up. If you use both templates, make sure the reminder email feels meaningfully different (shorter, more direct, or with a different subject line) so it doesn’t look like a duplicate. Customize the email design (colors & typography) Use the style settings to match your store branding and improve readability across devices and email clients. Email background color (the outer background around the content) Card background color (the main content container) Primary font color (headings and key text) Secondary font color (supporting text) Body content line height (spacing between lines for readability) For the best deliverability and readability, stick to high-contrast combinations (dark text on a light background) and avoid very light gray text. Customize the email header (logo & link) The header is typically where customers recognize your brand first. You can adjust the header so the email feels consistent with your storefront. Upload a header image or logo Set image width and height to fit neatly on desktop and mobile Add a link to the header image (for example, your homepage or a featured collection) Use a reasonably sized image to avoid slow loading in inboxes. Oversized header images can make the email feel “heavy” and reduce clicks. Edit email content Edit the text customers see in their inbox. Rivyo supports placeholders (for example, the customer’s name) so your emails feel personal at scale. Subject This is the subject line customers see in their inbox. Example: Give Your Feedback on Your Recent Purchase Salutation This controls how the email greets the customer. Example: Hi {customer}, {customer} automatically inserts the customer’s name (when available). Body Content This is the main message asking customers to leave a review. Keep it clear, friendly, and action-oriented. Example: Thank you for your recent order. We hope everything met your expectations. If you have a moment, we’d really appreciate a quick review of the items you received. If your store sells multiple items per order, consider wording that works for both single-item and multi-item purchases (for example, “the items you received”). Choose how customers leave a review (review collection type) Your template can be set up to collect reviews in different ways depending on your store’s preference and the customer experience you want: On-site review form — customers click from the email to your store and submit the review on the product page or a Rivyo review form. In-email actions (when available) — customers can start the review flow directly from the email, reducing steps. The exact options you see can vary depending on your Rivyo settings and your store setup. Choose the option that creates the fewest steps for customers while still capturing the details you need. Recommended workflow Choose Primary Review Request or Reminder Email depending on what you’re updating. Edit them separately so each email has its own tone and timing. Add your logo/header image, then set background and text colors. Confirm that the content is easy to read and looks good on both desktop and mobile. Use a subject that’s specific and friendly. Personalize the greeting with {customer} when appropriate. Mention the recent purchase, set expectations (“quick review”), and guide the customer to one clear action: leaving a review. If you enable reminders, shorten the message and change the subject line so it doesn’t feel like a duplicate of the first email. Best practices (deliverability & conversions) Avoid spammy wording (excessive punctuation, all caps, or “FREE!!!”). Use consistent branding so customers trust the email is from your store. Optimize for mobile by keeping paragraphs short and using readable font colors. Set expectations (for example, “takes 30 seconds”) to encourage completion. Be mindful with links—too many can distract from the main review action. FAQ They serve different purposes. The primary email introduces the request, while the reminder is a follow-up for customers who didn’t respond. Customizing both helps the reminder feel intentional rather than repetitive, which can improve review submissions. If the customer name can’t be pulled in, the email may display a more generic greeting depending on your store/customer data. To keep the greeting natural, consider writing it so it still reads well without a name (for example, “Hi there,”). Use a simple header image, high-contrast text colors, and short paragraphs. Avoid overly complex layouts and keep the main call-to-action easy to find.

pages.title: Reward Customers for Reviews with Discount Coupons • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Review Rewards lets you automatically reward customers with a discount coupon after they submit a review. This helps you collect more reviews (and more detailed reviews) while giving customers a clear reason to share feedback. With Review Rewards, you can: Automatically send discount coupons when a review is submitted Offer higher rewards for photo and video reviews Generate a unique coupon code for each customer (or use one shared code) Set a coupon expiration date and usage limits Restrict rewards to verified purchasers You can find this feature in Rivyo → Reviews → Collect → Review Rewards. Enable Review Rewards To start sending coupons for reviews, enable the feature and configure your reward settings. Go to Rivyo → Reviews, then open Collect and click Review Rewards. Enable Enable Review Rewards. Choose your coupon type (unique or shared), discount type, reward values, and rules like expiration and limits. Click Save. Once enabled, Rivyo generates reward coupons automatically when customers submit reviews (based on your settings). If you’re unsure where to start, begin with a small base reward and a short expiration (for example, 7–14 days). You can always adjust later based on results. Reward code types Choose how Rivyo generates coupon codes for reviewers. Generate unique code for each customer A new, unique discount code is created for every customer who submits a review. Best for: preventing code sharing and keeping rewards limited to the reviewer Customer experience: each customer receives their own code Use one shared code for all customers The same coupon code is sent to every customer who submits a review. Best for: simple management and consistent campaign messaging Consideration: shared codes can be forwarded or posted publicly more easily If you choose a shared code, set clear usage limits (and consider a shorter expiration) to reduce misuse. Discount types Choose what kind of discount customers receive. Percentage discount Customers receive a discount based on a percentage of the order total. Example: 10% off Fixed amount discount Customers receive a flat discount amount. Example: $10 off Percentage discounts usually scale well for higher-value carts. Fixed discounts can feel more concrete to customers on lower- to mid-value orders. Base reward (standard review) The Base Reward is the coupon customers receive for submitting a regular text review. You can typically configure: Discount value (percentage or fixed amount) Minimum order value required to use the coupon Expiration (how long the coupon remains valid) Usage limits (how many times the coupon can be used) Use a minimum order value to protect margins (for example, “$10 off orders over $50”) and to encourage higher average order value. Bonus rewards for photo & video reviews You can offer additional rewards when customers include media in their review: Photo reviews: typically more trustworthy and useful for shoppers Video reviews: often the highest impact and strongest social proof Bonus rewards help you collect richer customer content that improves product pages and increases confidence for new buyers. How bonus rewards work (recommended approach) Set a Base Reward for any review Add a higher bonus for photo reviews Add the highest bonus for video reviews To avoid abuse, pair media bonuses with Verified Purchaser only and set reasonable usage limits and expiration. Verified purchaser restriction If available in your settings, enable Verified Purchaser only to ensure rewards are only issued to customers who actually purchased the product. Benefit: reduces spam and incentivizes genuine feedback Best for: stores offering higher-value coupons or strong media bonuses Best practices Keep it simple: one clear base reward is better than many complicated rules. Use unique codes for higher rewards: unique codes reduce sharing and make rewards easier to control. Set a deadline: expirations create urgency and bring customers back sooner. Protect profitability: use minimum order value thresholds for fixed discounts. Incentivize quality: use photo/video bonuses to increase the usefulness of reviews. FAQ Yes. After you enable Review Rewards and click Save, Rivyo will generate and send reward coupons automatically based on the settings you configured. Unique codes are best when you want tighter control and less sharing. A shared code is simpler, but it’s easier for customers to forward or publish. Offer a bonus reward for photo or video reviews that is meaningfully higher than your base reward. Pair this with Verified Purchaser and a reasonable expiration to keep it sustainable. Use unique coupon codes Enable Verified Purchaser only (if available) Add expiration (shorter windows reduce sharing) Set usage limits and a minimum order value

pages.title: Customize Review Reward Email Template in Rivyo • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview When a customer submits a review and qualifies for a reward, Rivyo automatically emails them a discount coupon. You can customize this reward email so it matches your brand—colors, images, layout, and wording—while keeping the coupon easy to find and copy. What you can customize Email colors and styling Coupon display (card, background, border, and text colors) Header and footer images (with optional click-through links) Email subject and message content Additional store links (for example, Shop Now / Contact Us) The Reward Email Template controls the email sent for review rewards. It won’t change other Rivyo emails (like review requests) unless you edit those templates separately. Open the Reward Email Template In your Shopify admin, open Rivyo, then navigate to: Reviews → Collect → Review Rewards → Reward Email Template Use the editor on the left to make changes. The preview panel on the right shows how the email will look to customers. Make one change at a time and check the preview after each update. This makes it easier to spot what caused a layout or color issue. Email Template Settings The email template editor lets you customize both design (colors, spacing, images) and content (subject line and message text). Your changes apply to future reward emails sent after you save. Customize the coupon code design The coupon area is the most important part of the email. Use these settings to make the code stand out and remain readable on both desktop and mobile. Email Background Color – Sets the background color for the entire email. Card Background Color – Sets the background color of the coupon card (the section that contains the reward code). Font Colors – Controls text color throughout the email: Primary Font Color – Main headings and key text Secondary Font Color – Supporting text (descriptions, smaller details) Coupon Background Color – Changes the background color of the coupon display box. Coupon Text Color – Sets the text color of the coupon code. Coupon Code Border Color – Sets the border color around the coupon code section. Avoid low-contrast combinations (for example, light gray text on a white background). If the coupon code is hard to read, customers are more likely to abandon the purchase. Adjust content layout (spacing) Use line-height settings to improve readability—especially on mobile screens. Body Content Line Height – Adjusts spacing between lines in the main message text. Coupon Description Line Height – Adjusts spacing for the coupon description text near the code. If your message looks “crowded,” increase line height slightly. If the email becomes too long, reduce line height and shorten the message text. Customize the email header Add a branded header image (for example, a banner, logo, or seasonal promo). You can also make the image clickable. Upload a header image Turn on Header Override Default to replace the default header with your own. Click Upload an image and select your file. Adjust the width and height settings so the banner displays cleanly in the preview. Header image requirements Recommended size: 560px × 292px Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP (Optional) Add a header click link If your template includes a header redirect/link field, you can paste a URL so customers are taken to a page when they click the header image (for example, your homepage or a featured collection). If you add a link, make sure it goes to a page customers can access without logging in. Customize the email content (subject & message) The subject line helps customers recognize the email, and the message text explains what the reward is and how to use it. Email subject Edit Email Subject to match your brand voice and make the reward clear. Keep it short so it doesn’t get cut off on mobile. Make the reward obvious (for example, “Your discount code is inside”). Avoid excessive punctuation or ALL CAPS, which can reduce trust. Email body text Update the main message so customers know: They successfully submitted a review They earned a reward How to use the coupon at checkout A strong structure is: Thank you → Here’s your reward → How to use it → Shop now. Add additional links (recommended) If your template settings allow additional links, include 1–3 helpful destinations so customers can act immediately. Shop Now (homepage or a best-sellers collection) Contact Us (support page) Track Order (if you offer tracking) Too many links can distract customers from using the coupon. Keep the focus on the reward and checkout. Preview and finalize Check the right-side preview for spacing, readability, and whether the coupon section stands out. Confirm the subject line reads well, the coupon code is easy to spot, and text colors are readable against the background. Save the template so the updated design is used for future reward emails. Changes typically apply to emails sent after you save. Emails already sent to customers won’t be updated retroactively. FAQ Blurry headers are usually caused by uploading an image that’s smaller than the display size. Use the recommended dimensions (560px × 292px) and avoid stretching the image larger than its original size. Check contrast between these settings: Coupon Background Color, Coupon Text Color, and Coupon Code Border Color. Use a darker text color on a light background (or vice versa) and confirm in the preview. Yes. Start by matching your store’s primary brand color using Email Background, Card Background, and Primary Font Color. Then add a header image with your logo or banner for instant brand recognition. Include a short thank-you, a clear statement that the reward was earned, how to use the code at checkout, and (optionally) a “Shop now” link. Keep the coupon section visually prominent.

pages.title: Collect Reviews Using Link & QR Code • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Rivyo lets you collect customer reviews using a shareable link or a QR code. Customers can leave a review without logging in, which makes it easier to get more feedback from more places. Customers can simply: Scan a QR code Click a review link Search for a product (if needed) Submit a review in seconds This is especially useful for collecting reviews through: Email SMS WhatsApp Invoices and receipts Packaging inserts In-store displays Where to find it: Rivyo → Reviews → Collect Reviews → QR Code Types of Review QR Codes Rivyo provides two QR codes, depending on whether you want product reviews or store-level feedback. 1) All Products Review QR Code Use this QR code when you want one single code that works for every product in your store. When customers scan the code, they’ll be taken to a page where they can: Search for a product Select the correct product Write and submit their review Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Collect Reviews → QR Code. Open All Products Review QR Code. Click Download PNG to save it as an image you can print or share. Add the QR code to printed materials (receipts, inserts, signage) or send it as an image in email/SMS/WhatsApp. If you want the easiest “one-size-fits-all” setup for packaging inserts or in-store signage, use the All Products Review QR Code so you don’t need different codes for different items. You can also copy the shareable link shown with this QR code and send it directly to customers (no QR scan required). 2) Store Review QR Code Use this QR code when you want customers to review their overall store experience (instead of a specific product). This is helpful for collecting feedback about: Customer service Shipping experience Overall satisfaction Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Collect Reviews → QR Code. Find Store Review QR Code. Click Download PNG. Place it on receipts, delivery packages, thank-you cards, or at checkout for quick feedback. The Store Review QR Code is best when you want feedback on the shopping experience. For item-specific feedback (quality, sizing, usage), use the All Products Review QR Code instead. Using the Shareable Review Link Each QR code includes a shareable link. This is perfect when you want to ask for a review in a message where customers can simply tap and submit. Ways to share the link Email campaigns (post-purchase or reorder reminders) SMS messages WhatsApp messages Customer support conversations Post-purchase follow-ups (manual or automated) For the best response rate, send the link when the customer is most likely to have tried the product—commonly a few days after delivery. Where to Use Review QR Codes QR codes work best in physical touchpoints—anywhere a customer can scan quickly without typing a URL. Recommended placements Packaging inserts (thank-you cards, “How was your order?” cards) Receipts and invoices (printed or PDF) Product packaging labels (especially for repeat purchases) In-store signage (checkout counter, product display stand) Delivery bags/boxes (outside label or inside insert) Make sure your QR code is printed clearly and large enough to scan. Avoid placing it on glossy surfaces where reflections can prevent scanning. Choosing the Right Option Use All Products Review QR Code. Customers can search and select the product before submitting their review. Use the Store Review QR Code to collect overall experience feedback. Use a QR code for printed materials (in-store, packaging, receipts). Use the shareable link for digital messages (email, SMS, WhatsApp, support chat).

pages.title: Track and Manage Review Request Emails in Rivyo • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Review Email Activity (also called the Email Request Sent Report) is where you can track every review request email Rivyo sends from your automated review request workflow. Use this report to confirm emails were sent, check whether customers have reviewed, and quickly resend a request when needed. See which orders received a review request email Verify delivery status (for example, whether an email was sent) Track whether a review has been submitted after the email Identify blocked/excluded products that did not receive a request Resend a review request (when available) Where to find it Go to Rivyo → Collect → Review Requests → Review Email Activity. Use this page as your “source of truth” when a customer says “I didn’t get the review email.” You can confirm whether a request was sent, when it was scheduled, and whether any products were blocked from receiving requests. How Review Email Activity works When Rivyo sends an automated review request email after an order, Rivyo logs that request in the Review Email Activity dashboard. Each row represents a single review request event tied to an order/customer. The report helps you monitor your review collection by showing key details such as: Order number linked to the request Customer email the request was sent to Scheduled date (when the email was planned to send or was sent) Email status (current state of the request) Review submitted status (whether the customer has reviewed) Blocked products count (items excluded from the request) Actions (such as resending a request, when available) The Review Submitted status updates automatically if the customer submits a review later. Understanding the Review Email Activity dashboard The dashboard is a table with columns that help you quickly answer three questions: Was the email sent? Did the customer review? Was anything excluded? Order Shows the order number associated with the review request. Selecting the order number may take you to the order details (depending on your store/admin setup). Customer Email The email address the review request was sent to. Scheduled Date The date Rivyo scheduled the request to send (and/or the send date, depending on how your workflow is configured). Email Status Indicates the current state of the email request. Sent — The review request email was successfully sent to the customer. If your account shows additional statuses beyond Sent, use them to understand where the request is in the lifecycle (for example, scheduled vs. completed). The status names shown in your dashboard are the ones that apply to your store’s setup. Review Submitted Shows whether the customer has submitted a review after receiving the email. Not Received — No review has been submitted yet for that request. A “Not Received” status does not necessarily mean the customer didn’t open the email—it only means a review hasn’t been submitted yet. Blocked Products Shows how many products in the order were excluded from review requests. Products can be blocked due to settings such as: Product review limits (for example, restrictions on which products can receive requests) Review request restrictions (rules you configured for sending requests) Excluded products (items you intentionally blocked from receiving review emails) If an order contains blocked products, the customer may receive a request for only the eligible items—or the request may be limited—depending on your store’s review request rules. Always check your blocked/exclusion settings if you notice fewer requests than expected. Actions (Resend and more) The Actions column is where you manage an individual request. Common actions include resending a review request when a customer reports they didn’t receive the email. Common workflows Check whether a review request was sent for a specific order Go to Rivyo → Collect → Review Requests → Review Email Activity. Find the row for the order number (or match using the Customer Email column). Review the Email Status and Scheduled Date to confirm whether the request was sent and when. Look at Review Submitted to see whether the customer has already left a review. Resend a review request (when a customer didn’t receive it) In Review Email Activity, locate the order/customer. Confirm Email Status and make sure Review Submitted is not already completed for that request. In the Actions column, select the available Resend option (wording may vary by version). If you don’t see a resend option for a specific row, it can be due to your workflow rules, request state, or limits set in your review request settings. Understand why some products didn’t get a review request Find the order in Review Email Activity. Review the Blocked Products count for that order. If the count is higher than expected, review your product exclusions and review request restriction settings to ensure the right products are eligible. Troubleshooting A “Sent” status means Rivyo sent the message from the system. Delivery to the inbox can still be affected by the customer’s mailbox (spam, promotions tab, corporate filters, full inbox, etc.). Confirm the Customer Email matches the customer’s correct address. Resend the request from the Actions column (if available). Ask the customer to check spam/junk folders and search for your store name. The report updates automatically after the review is recorded. If it still shows “Not Received,” double-check that the review was submitted under the same customer/order context and give it a short time to refresh. Refresh the page and re-check the same order row. Confirm the review was submitted for the same products tied to that request. This usually indicates eligibility rules or exclusions are preventing certain items from receiving review requests. Review your excluded/blocked product settings. Check any review request restrictions (limits, rules, or eligibility conditions) that apply to products in that order. Best practices Check “Review Submitted” before resending to avoid sending unnecessary reminders to customers who already reviewed. Watch the “Blocked Products” column to catch unintended exclusions that reduce your review volume. Use Scheduled Date to validate timing if customers claim they received the request too early/late. If you’re optimizing review collection, periodically scan this report for patterns (for example, repeated blocked products or many “Not Received” rows) and adjust your eligibility rules accordingly.

pages.title: Send Review Requests for Past Orders with Rivyo Review Campaign • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Review Campaign lets you send a one-time batch of review request emails to customers who already placed orders in the past. It’s designed for “catch-up” review collection—so you don’t have to wait for automated review request schedules to reach older orders. This is useful when you want to: Collect reviews right after installing Rivyo Request reviews from older orders that never received a review email Boost review collection during a short promotion or seasonal period Run a targeted campaign for a specific order window (for example, last month’s orders) You can access this feature from Rivyo → Collect → Review Requests → Review Campaign. How Review Campaign works A Review Campaign sends review request emails to customers whose orders fall within a date range you choose. Rivyo uses that date range to find eligible orders, then sends a review request email to the customers attached to those orders. You choose a Start Date and End Date. Rivyo gathers orders placed within that period. Review request emails are sent to those customers. Use Review Campaign to “backfill” reviews for past orders. For ongoing collection, keep your automated review request emails enabled in your regular review request settings. Create a Review Campaign Follow these steps to send review requests to customers from past orders. Go to Rivyo → Collect → Review Requests, then open Review Campaign. Click Create Email Campaign. Choose your Start Date and End Date. Rivyo will include orders placed within this period. Click Create. Rivyo will begin sending review request emails for orders in the selected range. Review Campaign emails are sent in bulk. Double-check your date range before creating the campaign to avoid emailing the wrong customers. Campaign date range The date range controls which orders are included. Think of it as: “Send review requests for orders placed between these dates.” Start Date The beginning of the order period. Example: If your Start Date is Jan 1, orders placed on/after that date can be included (depending on how your store records order timestamps). End Date The final day of the order period. Example: If your End Date is Jan 31, orders placed up to that date can be included (depending on how your store records order timestamps). Maximum date range By default, Rivyo allows Review Campaigns for orders from the last 6 months. This limit helps maintain strong email performance and deliverability. If your goal is to collect reviews from orders older than the allowed window, consider splitting your approach: request reviews from the most recent eligible period first, then continue collecting reviews using automated review requests going forward. Track campaign status After you create a campaign, it appears in the Past Order Review Request list (on the Review Campaign page). This table helps you confirm what was sent and when. Common columns you’ll see include: Date created — when you started the campaign Campaign range — the Start Date and End Date used for order selection Status — the current sending progress Campaign status meanings In progress / Sending — Rivyo is currently sending review request emails for this campaign. Completed — all review request emails for the campaign have been processed and sent. If you don’t see expected results, confirm the campaign range includes real orders and give the campaign time to finish sending before creating another one for the same period. Best practices (recommended) Start with a smaller date range (for example, 1–2 weeks) to validate your email content and results before sending to a larger audience. Avoid overlapping campaigns for the same period to reduce the chance of customers receiving multiple review requests close together. Time campaigns around delivery when possible—customers are more likely to review after receiving the product. Use clear expectations in your email: keep the review request short and focused, and ensure your store branding is consistent. Sending multiple campaigns back-to-back to the same customer base can lead to higher unsubscribes or lower engagement. Space campaigns out and keep targeting specific. FAQ No. A Review Campaign is a manual, one-time send. You choose the order date range and create the campaign when you’re ready. Use Review Campaign when you want to collect reviews from past orders immediately (for example, right after installing Rivyo). Use automated review requests to continuously collect reviews from new orders going forward. If you selected an incorrect range, create a new campaign with the correct dates. To prevent duplicate outreach, avoid re-sending to the same order period unless you intentionally want to follow up.

pages.title: Understanding the Reviews Page • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: How to open the Reviews page The Reviews page is where you manage everything related to product and store reviews. Open Rivyo. From your Shopify dashboard, go to Apps and click Rivyo: Reviews & Loyalty. Click Reviews. In the left sidebar, click Reviews. The Reviews page opens on the Product Reviews tab. Top-right actions These four buttons appear at the top-right corner of the Reviews page and are available on every tab: ButtonWhat it does Trash reviewsOpens the Review Trash, where deleted reviews are held for 30 days before permanent removal. Export reviewsDownloads your reviews as a file so you can save or share them. Import reviewsOpens the import tool to bring in reviews from a CSV file, AliExpress, Amazon, or another app. ... (More actions)Additional options depending on your current view. The seven navigation tabs The Reviews page is organized into seven tabs across the top: TabWhat you find here Product ReviewsAll reviews for specific products in your store. This is where you spend most of your time. Store ReviewsReviews about your overall store experience (not linked to a specific product). Question & AnswersQuestions customers have submitted on product pages, and your answers. Collect ReviewsAll your tools for gathering reviews: email requests, QR codes, rewards, and moderation settings. ProductsA list of all your products showing their average rating and review counts. Widget StylingThe review display widgets you can add to your storefront pages. SettingsGoogle Shopping integration and language customization. The Product Reviews table The main table on the Product Reviews tab shows each review as a row. Here is what each column means: ColumnWhat it shows CustomerThe reviewer's name and email address. DateWhen the review was submitted. Rating & reviewThe star rating and the review text (title and body). SourceHow the review was collected (for example: email request, import, or manual entry). StatusWhether the review is Published (live on your store) or Unpublished (hidden from shoppers). FeaturedWhether the review is marked as Featured, which highlights it in certain widget layouts. ActionsButtons to manage the review: approve, reply, edit, delete, and more. Quick tip: When you first start using Rivyo, this table will be empty. Use the Launch Review Campaign button to send review requests to past customers, or the Import Reviews button to bring in existing reviews.

pages.title: How to Reply to a Customer Review • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Why reply to reviews?Replying to reviews shows customers that you care about their experience. Your reply appears publicly on your store, next to the original review. This builds trust with both the reviewer and future shoppers who read the exchange.A good reply also lets you address concerns, correct misunderstandings, or simply say thank you for positive feedback.How to write a replyOpen Rivyo. Go to your Shopify dashboard, click Apps, and open Rivyo: Reviews & Loyalty.Click Reviews. In the left sidebar, click Reviews. The Product Reviews tab opens.Find the review. Browse or search the review table to find the review you want to reply to.Click the Actions button. In the Actions column for that review, click the actions button or icon.Select Reply. Click Reply. A text field opens where you can type your response.Type your reply. Keep it polite, professional, and relevant to what the customer wrote.Submit the reply. Click the button to save and publish your reply.Your reply is now visible on the product page, displayed directly below the customer's review.Tips for writing good repliesFor positive reviews: Thank the customer by name if possible. Keep it brief and genuine.For negative reviews: Acknowledge the issue, apologize sincerely, and offer a resolution. Avoid being defensive.For neutral reviews: Thank them for the feedback and mention any improvements you have made based on their comments.Keep it short. A reply of two to three sentences is usually enough. Long replies can feel overwhelming.Always be professional. Your reply is public. Other shoppers will read it and form an impression of your store.✅ Quick tip: Replying to every review — even just a simple 'Thank you!' — shows shoppers that your store is active and cares about customers. Try to reply to negative reviews within 24 hours. A fast, helpful response often reassures other shoppers more than the original complaint unsettles them.Editing or removing a replyIf you need to change a reply you have already submitted:Find the review. Go to Reviews and locate the review with your reply.Click the Actions button. Open the action menu for that review.Select Edit Reply or Delete Reply. Choose the option that matches what you need.Changes take effect immediately on your store.

pages.title: How to Approve or Unpublish a Review • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Published vs. unpublished reviewsEvery review in Rivyo has a status: Published or Unpublished.Published. The review is live on your store. Shoppers can see it on the product page.Unpublished. The review is saved in Rivyo but hidden from shoppers. It will not appear on your store until you publish it.How reviews get their statusWhen a new review comes in, its status depends on your Auto-Publish settings:Auto-Publish is set to All. Every new review is published automatically. You do not need to approve anything manually.Auto-Publish is off or conditional. New reviews arrive as unpublished and wait for you to review and approve them.ℹ️ Note: You can change your Auto-Publish setting at any time. Go to Reviews → Collect Reviews → Publishing and moderation.How to publish (approve) a reviewIf a review is unpublished and you want to make it live on your store:Go to Reviews. Open Rivyo and click Reviews in the left sidebar.Find the review. Locate the review in the Product Reviews table. The Status column will show Unpublished.Click the Actions menu. Click the actions button for that review (usually a button or icon in the Actions column).Select Publish. Click Publish. The review status changes to Published immediately.The review is now live on your store.How to unpublish a reviewIf you want to hide a published review from your store without deleting it:Go to Reviews. Open Rivyo and click Reviews.Find the review. Locate the published review in the table.Click the Actions menu. Click the actions button for that review.Select Unpublish. Click Unpublish. The review status changes to Unpublished immediately.The review is still saved in Rivyo but no longer visible to shoppers.How to set up auto-publishingTo avoid approving reviews one by one, you can let Rivyo publish them automatically.Click the Collect Reviews tab. On the Reviews page, click Collect Reviews.Click Publishing and moderation. Select this option from the cards shown.Find Auto-Publish Reviews. In the Auto-Publish Reviews section, use the dropdown to choose your preference.Select All to publish every review automatically, or choose a specific star rating threshold if you only want higher-rated reviews to auto-publish.Save your settings.⚠️ Note: Auto-publishing applies to new reviews only. Existing unpublished reviews still need to be approved manually.

pages.title: How to Delete a Review and Restore from Trash • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: How review deletion works in RivyoWhen you delete a review in Rivyo, it is not removed immediately. It is moved to the Review Trash, where it stays for 30 days. During that time, you can restore it if you change your mind.After 30 days, reviews in the Trash are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.⚠️ Important: Deleted reviews disappear from your store immediately after deletion. However, they remain in the Trash for 30 days and can be restored during that period. After 30 days, they are gone permanently.How to delete a reviewOpen Rivyo. Go to your Shopify dashboard, click Apps, and open Rivyo: Reviews & Loyalty.Click Reviews. In the left sidebar, click Reviews.Find the review. Locate the review you want to delete in the Product Reviews table.Click the Actions button. Click the actions button in the Actions column for that review.Select Delete. Click Delete. Confirm the action if prompted.The review is removed from your store and moved to the Trash.How to restore a deleted reviewIf you deleted a review by mistake, you can restore it within 30 days.Go to the Reviews page. Open Rivyo and click Reviews.Click Trash reviews. At the top-right of the Reviews page, click the Trash reviews button. The Review Trash page opens. You can see all recently deleted reviews, along with how many days each one has left before permanent deletion.Find the review. Use the search bar to filter by customer name or email, or scroll through the list.Click the Actions button. Click the actions button for the review you want to restore.Select Restore. Click Restore. The review is moved back to your Reviews list.The review is now unpublished. You can publish it again from the Reviews page if you want it visible on your store.How to restore all deleted reviews at onceIf you want to restore every review in the Trash at once:Go to Reviews and click Trash reviews.Click the Restore All button at the top-right of the Trash page.All reviews in the Trash are restored to your Reviews list at the same time.How to permanently delete reviewsIf you want to clear the Trash before the 30-day period ends:Go to Trash reviews. Click the Trash reviews button on the Reviews page.Click Empty trash. Click the Empty trash button at the top-right.Confirm the action when prompted. All reviews in the Trash are permanently deleted immediately.⚠️ Warning: Empty trash is permanent. Reviews deleted this way cannot be recovered. Only click Empty trash if you are certain you no longer need those reviews.Review Trash table columnsThe Trash page shows these columns for each deleted review:ColumnWhat it showsCustomerThe reviewer's name and email.DateWhen the review was originally submitted.Rating & reviewThe star rating and review content.StatusThe review's status before deletion.SourceHow the review was collected.Days remainingHow many days are left before the review is permanently deleted.ActionsOptions to restore or permanently delete that specific review.

pages.title: Create and Manage Product Groups for Reviews in Rivyo • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: OverviewProduct Groups let you combine multiple Shopify products into a single group so you can manage their reviews, ratings, customer photos/videos, and Q&A together in Rivyo.This is most useful when the same item is sold as separate products (for example, sizes/colors listed as separate products), or when multiple listings should share the same customer feedback.When to use Product GroupsSeparate products that are really variants (same item, different size/color material, but created as separate products)Multiple SKUs for the same design (bundles, multipacks, or regional SKUs)Products in the same collection that should share social proofItems with the same customer feedback (e.g., replacement parts or identical re-listings)If your products are true Shopify variants inside one product, you typically don’t need a Product Group—those reviews are already tied to the same product.
