Use Product Groups when the items are set up as separate Shopify products.Where to find Product GroupsIn your Shopify admin, open Rivyo, then go to: Reviews → Products → Product GroupHow Product Groups workWhen you add products to a group, Rivyo treats the group as one shared feedback hub:Reviews are combined across all products in the groupRatings are calculated using reviews from the entire groupCustomer media is shared (photos/videos appear across grouped products)Questions & Answers are shared within the same groupThe main benefit is stronger social proof: customers can see more reviews and richer media even if each individual product listing has fewer reviews.Product Groups are designed for products that should share the same feedback. If you group different items that don’t match, customers may see reviews that don’t apply to what they’re buying.Create a Product GroupCreate a group when you want multiple products to share reviews, ratings, media, and Q&A.Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Products → Product Group.Click Create Group.Enter a clear name customers and staff can recognize (for example, Classic Hoodie (All Colors)).Choose the products you want to include in the group.Click Save. The selected products will now share the same combined reviews, ratings, media, and Q&A.Use a naming pattern that scales, such as Product Name + (All Variants) or Design Name + Edition. This makes groups easy to find later.View Product GroupsAfter you create groups, they appear in the Product Groups dashboard.What you’ll see in the dashboardGroup nameProducts in the groupCreation dateTotal number of products in the groupFrom this dashboard, you can open a group to manage it, or use the available actions to edit or remove a group.Deleting a Product Group cannot be undone. Before deleting, confirm you won’t need the grouped view of reviews, media, and Q&A. If you’re unsure, consider removing a product from the group instead of deleting the entire group.Manage products in a groupOpen a group to review what’s included and to make changes. Inside the group, you’ll typically see:Product list included in the groupAverage rating based on all grouped reviewsPublished reviews count and listUnpublished reviews count and list (pending/moderation)Add products to a groupFrom Rivyo → Reviews → Products → Product Group, click the group you want to update.Click Add Products, select the products to include, then click Save.Remove products from a groupClick the group you want to update.In the group’s product list, remove the product you no longer want included, then Save your changes.Removing a product from a group separates it from the group’s combined feedback going forward. If you later add it back, it will again share the group’s combined reviews, ratings, media, and Q&A.Manage reviews, media, and Q&A in a Product GroupA Product Group centralizes moderation—so you don’t have to manage the same type of feedback across multiple product listings. Inside a group, use the available tabs to review and moderate content for all grouped products in one place.Use the Products tab to:Confirm which products are currently in the groupAdd products to the group or remove them from the groupQuickly spot mismatches (for example, an item that shouldn’t share the same reviews)Use the Reviews tab to manage reviews across the entire group:Review both published and unpublished reviews for all grouped productsApprove or unpublish reviews based on your moderation rulesRespond to customer reviews (if responses are enabled in your setup)Track the group’s overall sentiment using the combined rating and review listIf a review clearly refers to a specific variation (for example, “the red one runs small”), Product Groups are ideal—customers on related listings still benefit from the context.Use the Media tab to manage customer photos and videos for the group:See all customer-uploaded media from grouped products in one placeModerate media so only relevant, high-quality content appearsUse shared media to strengthen product pages that have fewer media submissionsIf products in the group look meaningfully different (for example, different prints, shapes, or materials), shared media may confuse shoppers. Only group products that customers would consider the “same item.”Use the Q&A tab to manage questions and answers across grouped products:Moderate new questionsPost answers that apply to all grouped productsKeep repeated questions from appearing across multiple listingsFor questions that apply to only one specific product in the group, include the relevant detail in your answer (for example, “For the XL listing…” or “For the bundle pack…”).Best practicesGroup only truly similar items. Customers should expect the same core product experience.Keep groups focused. Smaller, accurate groups are better than one oversized group.Moderate early after grouping. Right after creating a group, scan the combined reviews/media to ensure everything fits.Use clear group names. This prevents mistakes when multiple staff members manage reviews.

pages.title: Product-wise Reviews Listing • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Product-wise Reviews Listing in Rivyo helps you review and manage feedback per product. Instead of scanning one long list of reviews for your entire store, this view groups reviews by product so you can quickly: identify best-performing items, spot products that need attention, and take action on reviews in context. Where to find it Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Products What you can do from this section See each product’s average rating and review counts at a glance Open a product to view and moderate its reviews Enable/disable review requests for a specific product (if available in your plan/settings) Generate a product review QR code (so customers can leave a review quickly) Set limits related to reviews for a product (for example, restrictions configured in your Rivyo settings) Track which products have published vs unpublished reviews Use the Products view as a weekly check-in: prioritize products with high traffic but low review counts, and products with a rising number of unpublished reviews. How Product-wise Reviews work The Products list shows all products in your store along with key review information for each one. This helps you quickly find products that: have strong ratings and could be highlighted in marketing have low review volume and may need review requests enabled have reviews waiting for moderation What you’ll see in each product row Product title The name of the product. Average rating The overall rating calculated from the reviews submitted for that product. Published reviews Reviews currently visible on your storefront. Unpublished reviews Reviews that are hidden or pending moderation (not visible on your storefront). The exact columns and available actions can vary depending on your Rivyo version and enabled features, but the workflow stays the same: pick a product, then manage reviews for that product. View reviews for a specific product To open and manage reviews for a single product, use the Actions menu from the Products list. Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Products. Locate the product you want to review in the list (scroll or use any available search/filter options). Click the Actions menu (⋯) for that product. Select View Reviews to open the product’s review page. Understand the Product Review Details page When you open a product’s review page, Rivyo shows both a summary and the individual reviews—so you can understand sentiment quickly and take action. Review insights you may see Average product rating Rating breakdown (1–5 stars) Customer media (images and videos submitted with reviews, if any) All reviews submitted for that product What each review typically includes Status (Published/Unpublished) Date the review was submitted Title and review content (if provided) Customer name (as submitted) Rating (stars) Source (where the review came from, if shown) If a review includes photos or videos, check media quality before publishing—especially for branded products where packaging and labeling matter. Moderate and manage individual reviews You can moderate reviews directly from the product’s review page. This helps you keep your storefront trustworthy and ensure reviews meet your store’s guidelines. Common actions (from the review’s Actions menu) Publish / Unpublish Show or hide a review on your storefront. Pin Keep an important review at the top of the list (helpful for standout reviews). Edit Adjust review text fields if your workflow allows it (for example, removing personal information or fixing obvious formatting issues). If you edit customer-submitted content, keep changes minimal and consistent with your review policy. Avoid changing the meaning of the customer’s feedback. Product-level review tools (Requests, QR codes, Limits) From the Rivyo → Reviews → Products list, the Actions menu may also include product-level tools that help you collect and manage reviews more effectively. If review requests are available in your setup, you can turn them on or off for individual products from the product’s Actions menu. This is useful when: a product is discontinued or temporarily unavailable you want to pause requests during a packaging/quality change you only want to collect reviews for selected products Consider enabling requests first for high-volume products—more orders usually means faster review growth. A review QR code lets customers open the product review form by scanning with their phone camera. This works well for in-store pickups, inserts, and post-purchase cards. Typical workflow: Open the product’s Actions menu Select the QR code option (name may vary) Download or copy the QR code for printing or sharing Place the QR code near a clear call-to-action like “Scan to leave a review” so customers know what it’s for. If your Rivyo settings include product-level limits, you can configure them from the product’s Actions menu. Limits help you control how reviews are collected and displayed (based on what your store needs). After changing limits, double-check the product’s review display on your storefront to ensure it matches your intended customer experience. Best practices Review unpublished items regularly to keep your storefront up to date and avoid moderation backlogs. Pin 1–3 high-quality reviews (clear details, photos, helpful context) for your best-selling products. Watch for patterns in low ratings on a specific product—issues like sizing, materials, or instructions often repeat. Troubleshooting (quick checks) Unpublished reviews are hidden by design. Open the product’s review page and publish the reviews you want displayed. Open View Reviews for the product and check whether reviews are unpublished, filtered, or pinned. If you use storefront widgets, confirm the widget is enabled and placed correctly in your theme. Those options may depend on your enabled features, plan, or settings. If the option isn’t in the product Actions menu, it may be managed from a different Rivyo settings area.

pages.title: Manage and Moderate Store Reviews in Rivyo • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Store Reviews section lets you collect and manage feedback about your overall store experience (not individual products). Store reviews help shoppers understand what it’s like to buy from you—based on real customer experiences. Customer service Product quality Shipping experience Overall satisfaction You can access this section from: Rivyo → Reviews → Store Reviews From this page, you can: View all store reviews in one place Publish or unpublish reviews (moderation) Reply to customer reviews Feature selected reviews as testimonials Share reviews on social media Delete unwanted reviews Publish only the reviews you’re comfortable showing publicly, but avoid removing all negative feedback—having a mix of reviews often looks more trustworthy to shoppers. How Store Reviews Work Store reviews capture feedback about the overall shopping experience with your store. The flow typically looks like this: A customer submits a store review using your Store Review widget. The review appears in your Store Reviews dashboard in Rivyo. You moderate the review (publish/unpublish), reply, and optionally feature it as a testimonial. Published reviews can appear publicly on your storefront (based on your widget/theme setup). Store reviews are separate from product reviews. If you want feedback on specific items, use the Product Reviews section. Add the Store Review Widget to Collect Reviews Customers can only submit store reviews if the Store Review widget is added to your storefront. Steps to add the widget Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Store Reviews. Click Manage Widget. Click Open the Shopify Theme Editor (or open your Shopify theme editor and navigate to the page/section where you want the widget). In the theme editor, add the Rivyo Store Reviews block/section where you want customers to leave reviews. Click Save in the theme editor. If you don’t see the Rivyo block in the theme editor, make sure the Rivyo app is installed and that you’re editing a compatible theme section (some themes restrict which blocks can be added to certain templates). Understanding the Store Reviews Dashboard The Store Reviews dashboard lists every review submitted about your store. Each row/card includes key details so you can moderate quickly and respond appropriately. What you’ll see for each review Customer The name of the customer who submitted the review. Date The date the review was submitted (or added). Rating & Review The star rating and the customer’s written feedback. If the review includes photos or videos, you’ll see a View media option. Source How the review was added. Common examples include Direct submission, CSV import, or other connected sources. Status Whether the review is visible on your storefront: Published — the review can appear publicly (where your store reviews widget/testimonial display is enabled). Unpublished — the review is hidden from shoppers and only visible to you in Rivyo. Use Unpublished for moderation (for example: reviews with private information, spam, or content that violates your store policy). Moderate reviews (Publish / Unpublish) Moderation controls whether a review is visible to customers. You can publish reviews you want to display and keep others unpublished. Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Store Reviews. Find the review you want to manage and open its actions (or click into the review, depending on your layout). Choose Publish to show it publicly or Unpublish to hide it. If you publish a review but don’t see it on your storefront, confirm that the Store Reviews widget is added and saved in your theme, and that you’re viewing the page where the widget is placed. Reply to a customer review Replies help you build trust by acknowledging feedback and showing how you handle issues. Replies are especially helpful for neutral/negative reviews. In Rivyo → Reviews → Store Reviews, locate the review you want to respond to. Click Reply and write a clear, helpful response. Save your reply so it appears with the review (where supported by your storefront display settings). Keep replies specific and actionable. If the issue involves an order, invite the customer to contact support with their order number rather than discussing private details publicly. Feature testimonials Featuring a review highlights it as a testimonial so you can showcase your best feedback in marketing areas (for example, a homepage section). Pick reviews that are specific (mention fast shipping, great support, packaging, etc.) rather than one-word feedback. Use the review’s actions and select Feature (or Mark as testimonial, depending on your UI). Make sure your theme has a testimonials/store reviews section enabled if you want featured reviews to appear in a dedicated area. Featuring a review does not always replace publishing. In most setups, a review should also be Published to be visible on the storefront. Share a review on social media Sharing positive store reviews can improve social proof and drive new purchases. In Rivyo → Reviews → Store Reviews, open the review you want to share. Click Share (or the share option in the review actions). Select the social platform option provided (or copy the share content/link if offered) and publish it to your social account. Share reviews that include specific outcomes (e.g., “arrived in 2 days”, “support solved it in 10 minutes”). Specifics tend to convert better than generic praise. Delete a store review Deleting removes a review from your dashboard and storefront displays. Deleting a review is permanent and cannot be undone. If you might need the review later, consider Unpublish instead of deleting. Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Store Reviews and locate the review. Select Delete from the review actions. Confirm the deletion when prompted. FAQ Most commonly, this happens for one of these reasons: The Store Review widget isn’t added to the correct page/template in your theme. The theme changes weren’t saved in the Shopify theme editor. You’re viewing a page that does not include the widget/section where store reviews display. The review is still Unpublished (double-check the status). It’s usually better to reply and resolve the issue (and keep the review published if it’s legitimate). Shoppers often trust stores more when they see transparent feedback and professional responses. Consider Unpublish or Delete only for spam, abusive content, or reviews containing private/personal information. Store reviews are about the overall shopping experience (service, shipping, satisfaction). Product reviews are tied to specific items and appear on product pages. Related pages Learn how to moderate, reply to, and display reviews for individual products. Add and configure Rivyo widgets in your Shopify theme. Bring existing reviews into Rivyo and manage them in one place.

pages.title: Store Reviews Widget – Display Store-Level Customer Reviews • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text:
Overview The Store Reviews Widget lets you display reviews about your overall store experience—not just reviews for individual products. Store reviews help you showcase customer satisfaction with your brand, support, shipping, and the full shopping journey. Adding store reviews to key pages can increase trust and reduce buying hesitation by showing real customer feedback where shoppers are deciding to purchase. If you already collect product reviews, store reviews are a great complement—use them on your homepage or a dedicated “Reviews” page to highlight your overall reputation. What the Store Reviews widget displays Depending on your settings, the widget can show: Average store rating (overall score) Total number of store reviews Written review content Reviewer name (and profile image if available) Verified badge (when enabled/available) Review date Review images (if your store allows photo reviews) Shoppers can also submit a store review directly from this widget (if the submission option is enabled in your widget settings). The exact fields (photos, verification badge, reviewer avatar, submission form) depend on your widget configuration and what customers provide. Where the widget can appear You can place the Store Reviews Widget on: A dedicated store reviews page (recommended for SEO and easy sharing) Your homepage (to build trust immediately) Landing pages (e.g., campaigns, collections, seasonal promotions) Any page supported by Shopify app blocks (Online Store 2.0 themes) If your theme supports Shopify app blocks, using the Theme Editor method is the fastest and safest option. Add Store Reviews to your store Rivyo supports two ways to add the Store Reviews widget. Method 1: Add using Shopify Theme Editor (Recommended) This method works with Online Store 2.0 themes and uses Shopify app blocks. In your Shopify Admin, go to Online Store → Themes. Find your current theme, then click Customize. In the Theme Editor, use the top dropdown (page selector) to open the template where you want store reviews to appear (for example: Home page, a Page template, or another supported template). In the left sidebar, click Add block. Select Store Reviews (Rivyo app block). Drag the block to the position you want (commonly below your hero section or near trust elements). Click Save. For best conversion impact, place store reviews near high-intent areas (e.g., below key benefits, shipping/returns highlights, or above your featured collection). Method 2: Manual installation (for older themes) If your theme does not support Shopify app blocks (or you’re using a heavily customized/legacy theme), you can add the widget by inserting a small snippet in your theme. Manual theme edits can affect your storefront if placed in the wrong file or location. If you’re not comfortable editing theme code, consider duplicating your theme first in Online Store → Themes. Go to: Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Store Reviews Copy this code exactly:
Paste the code into the template or section file where you want the widget to appear (for example, a custom page template or page section). Save the file, then preview your store to confirm the widget displays correctly. Customize the Store Reviews widget You can control the layout, sorting, and what content shoppers see so the widget matches your store’s design and goals. In Rivyo, go to Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Store Reviews. Update the options you want (examples below), then save your changes. Check the page where the widget is installed to confirm spacing, readability, and that the widget matches your theme. If needed, return to the widget settings to fine-tune. Common customization options Layout style (list, grid, carousel—depending on your theme/widget version) Number of reviews per row (helps control density and readability) Number of reviews shown (how many appear before “load more”/pagination, if enabled) Sorting (e.g., newest first, highest rating—depending on available options) Show/hide reviewer details (name, avatar) Show/hide review images Show/hide verified badge (if available) Colors and typography (to match your theme styling) Keep the widget easy to scan: limit the number of reviews shown at once and prioritize a clean layout on mobile. Best practices Create a dedicated “Store Reviews” page and link it in your header/footer for credibility and easy discovery. Place the widget near trust signals (shipping info, guarantees, secure checkout badges). Use sorting that fits your brand—“Newest first” keeps the section fresh; “Highest rating” emphasizes reputation. Enable review photos (if available) to make reviews feel more authentic and engaging. Troubleshooting Make sure you clicked Save in the Theme Editor. Confirm you added the block to the correct template/page (use the top page selector in the editor). If you have caching apps or performance tools enabled, try a hard refresh or check in an incognito window. Confirm the code is pasted exactly as shown:
Make sure the code is placed in a storefront-visible file (not an email template or admin-only file). Check that your store has at least one store review available to display. Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Store Reviews and adjust colors/typography/layout. Try reducing the number of reviews per row for better spacing on mobile. Preview on both desktop and mobile to confirm readability.

pages.title: Product Rating Badge – Show Star Ratings on Shopify Product Cards • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Product Rating Badge shows a product’s average star rating and total number of reviews directly on your storefront. When shoppers can see ratings on collection and featured sections, they can spot best-sellers faster and feel confident before opening a product page. You can display the badge on: Collection pages Product cards and product grids Featured product sections Homepage product sections For the biggest impact, place the badge where shoppers scan first: under the product title or near the price on collection pages. What the Product Rating Badge shows The badge typically includes: Average star rating (for example, 4.6 ★) Total number of reviews (for example, 25 Reviews) An optional rating label next to the review count (for example, Reviews) The badge pulls rating data from the reviews collected in Rivyo. If a product has no reviews yet, the badge may not appear until at least one review is published (depending on your widget settings and theme layout). Where the badge appears Common placements include: Below the product title (collection pages and product pages) Near the price Inside product cards on collection pages Featured product sections (homepage or landing pages) Once added, the badge automatically displays the correct rating for each product. Install the Product Rating Badge Follow these steps to add the badge to your Shopify theme using app blocks. In your Shopify admin: Go to Online Store → Themes. Find your active theme and select Customize. In the theme editor, use the top page selector to open the template where you want the badge, such as: Products (product page) Collections (collection page / product grid) Home page (featured product sections) In the left sidebar, click Add block in the section where you want the badge. Under Apps, select Rivyo. Choose Product Review Badge. Drag and drop the Product Review Badge block to the spot you want. Popular placements: Directly below the product title Below the price Near the Add to cart button (product pages) Click Save in the theme editor. Open your storefront and check a product that already has reviews to confirm the badge displays. If you don’t see the badge after saving, test with a product that has at least one published review. Some themes also hide empty elements on grids, which can make “no reviews yet” products look like the badge is missing. Customize the Product Rating Badge You can adjust how the badge looks and how the text is displayed from inside Rivyo. In Shopify admin, open Rivyo. Go to Reviews. Select Widget Styling. Open Product Badge Rating. In Rating Text, customize the wording shown next to the rating count. Example format: 4.2 ★ (25 Reviews) You can change the label Reviews to match your store tone (for example: ratings, customer reviews, or your store language). Save the settings in Rivyo, then refresh your storefront to see the updated badge. Example: what shoppers see On collection pages and featured product sections, the badge appears as a star rating with a review count (for example, 4.6 ★ (25 Reviews)). This gives shoppers quick proof of quality without needing to open the product page. Confirm you added the correct block: In the Shopify theme editor, make sure the block is Product Review Badge under the Rivyo app blocks. Check a product with reviews: Test on a product that has at least one published review. Verify placement: If the badge is inside a product card/grid, try moving it directly under the product title to ensure it’s not being hidden by spacing or layout rules. Refresh cache/theme preview: After saving changes, refresh the storefront and (if applicable) view in an incognito window. For highest visibility on listing pages, place the badge: Under the product title (best for scanning) Near the price (helps reinforce value) If you’re showing multiple trust elements (badges, shipping info, sale labels), keep the rating badge close to the title/price and avoid pushing it below the fold.

pages.title: All Product Reviews Page – Display All Reviews in One Place • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The All Product Reviews widget lets you showcase reviews from every product in your store in one place. It’s ideal for creating a dedicated Reviews page (a central hub for customer feedback) and for adding social proof to high-traffic areas like your homepage or landing pages. Shoppers can browse recent feedback across your catalog, discover what customers are saying, and build confidence before buying. If you’re creating a dedicated Reviews page, add it to your store’s main menu so shoppers can find it easily (Shopify Admin → Online Store → Navigation). Where you can display the widget You can place the All Product Reviews widget in multiple locations, depending on your theme setup: A dedicated Reviews page (recommended for a full “wall of reviews” experience) Homepage (great for instant trust) Landing pages (useful for campaigns and product collections) Any page that supports Shopify app blocks via the theme editor App blocks are available in Shopify’s Online Store 2.0 themes. If you don’t see “Add block” options in the theme editor, your theme may not support app blocks. Create a dedicated “All Reviews” page Rivyo can automatically generate a new Shopify page that displays reviews from all products. In Shopify Admin, go to Apps → Rivyo Reviews & Loyalty. Go to Reviews → Widget Styling. Select All Product Review. In the Create a Review Page section: Enter a clear Page Name (for example, All Reviews or Customer Reviews). Click Create Page. Rivyo will generate a new page that displays reviews across your store. In Shopify Admin, go to Online Store → Navigation. Choose the menu where you want the link to appear (for example, Main menu or Footer menu). Click Add menu item, then select the page you just created. Click Save. Display All Product Reviews using a Shopify app block If you don’t need a dedicated page—or you want reviews in multiple places—you can add the All Product Reviews widget as an app block in your theme. In Shopify Admin, go to Online Store → Themes. Find your live theme, then click Customize. Use the top dropdown (page selector) in the theme editor to switch to the template where you want the widget (for example, Home page or a specific page template). In the left sidebar, click Add section or Add block (depending on where you’re placing it). Select the Rivyo block named All Product Reviews. Drag the block to the position you want (for example, below your hero banner or above your footer). Click Save. For best conversion impact on landing pages, place the widget near key decision points (below benefits/features and above the final call-to-action). Customize the All Product Reviews layout You can adjust how the widget looks and how reviews are displayed from: Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → All Product Review. Layout options Layout style Choose the overall layout of review cards (for example, a masonry-style grid). Columns per row Control how many review cards appear in each row (common options: 2, 3, or 4 columns). Reviews per page Set how many reviews display before pagination appears. Use fewer per page to keep pages fast and scannable. Sort reviews by Choose the default order visitors see (for example, most recent first). This affects the first impression of your review feed. If you want the page to feel “fresh,” choose a sort option that prioritizes newer reviews. If you want to highlight strong social proof, choose an option that surfaces your best-rated reviews first (if available in your widget settings). Recommended settings (best practices) Dedicated Reviews page: Use 3 or 4 columns on desktop and a comfortable number of reviews per page so visitors can browse without endless scrolling. Homepage: Use fewer reviews per page and place the widget lower on the page to support—not replace—your main homepage message. Landing pages: Place reviews close to the offer and keep the layout tight so the page stays focused. Troubleshooting Confirm you’re using an Online Store 2.0 theme that supports app blocks. In the theme editor, make sure you’re adding a block in a section that allows blocks. Try refreshing the theme editor after installing/updating the app. Confirm your store has published reviews to display. Check if your widget settings include filters or display rules that could hide reviews. If you recently imported reviews, wait a moment and reload the page. Reduce Columns per row (mobile-friendly layouts usually display 1–2 cards per row depending on theme behavior). Try a different Layout style that stacks cards more naturally. If your theme has tight padding, consider placing the widget inside a section with standard spacing. Related Learn how to match Rivyo widgets to your storefront design. Control which reviews appear and how they’re ordered. Place Rivyo widgets in your theme using Shopify’s editor.

pages.title: Product Review Widget – Display Product Reviews on Shopify Product Pages • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Product Review Widget displays your customer reviews directly on your product pages, so shoppers can see real feedback before they buy. Showing ratings and reviews on-product helps build trust and can improve conversion. What the widget can show Average star rating (overall score for the product) Rating breakdown (how many 5-star, 4-star, etc.) Customer reviews (written feedback) Product Q&A (questions from shoppers and answers) Customer photos (images attached to reviews) Verified buyer badges (when enabled and supported by your settings) For best results, place the widget where it’s easy to find without interrupting buying intent—most stores use the area below the product description or below the “Add to cart” section. Where the widget appears The Product Review Widget appears on your product pages, typically below the product description. Once installed, it automatically displays the reviews submitted for the specific product the shopper is viewing. You can install and customize it from: Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Product Review If your theme uses a highly customized product template, the widget may appear in a slightly different position depending on how the product page is structured. Install the Product Review Widget Go to Shopify Admin for the store where you want the widget to appear. Navigate to Apps → Rivyo Reviews & Loyalty. In Rivyo, open Reviews → Widget Styling, then find Product Review. Click Install. After installation, the widget will be added to your product pages. If you don’t see the widget after installing, confirm you’re viewing an actual product page (not a preview page without product data), and that the product has reviews (or your settings allow showing an empty state). Customize the Product Review Widget You can control how the widget looks and behaves from the Product Review settings page: Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Product Review Layout & Structure These settings control how reviews are arranged and displayed on the product page. Average Rating Layout Choose how the rating summary appears at the top of the widget. Depending on your selected style, the summary can include: Overall rating (average stars) Total review count Rating distribution (bars showing how many reviews fall into each star level) Review Layout Style Choose how review cards are displayed: Grid layout (reviews shown in tiles/cards) List layout (reviews shown one after another in a vertical list) This setting affects how each review appears to shoppers (spacing, density, and how quickly they can scan reviews). Columns Per Row (Grid layout) If you use Grid layout, set how many review cards appear in each row (for example: 2, 3, or 4 columns). On mobile, fewer columns usually improves readability. If your theme is narrow, try 2 columns to avoid cramped review cards. Reviews Per Page Choose how many reviews appear before shoppers need to move to the next page (pagination). Lower values keep the product page shorter; higher values reduce how often shoppers need to paginate. Sorting & Publishing These options control the order of reviews and what shoppers see first. Sorting Preference Choose the default sort order on your storefront. Common options include: Most Recent (newest reviews first) Highest Rating (5-star first) Lowest Rating (1-star first) If your storefront allows shoppers to change the sort order, this setting controls the default view when the widget first loads. Product Q&A Product Q&A lets shoppers ask questions directly on the product page, and view answers in the same widget. This is helpful for common pre-purchase questions (fit, sizing, compatibility, materials, shipping details, etc.). Enable Product Q&A Turn this on to display a Q&A section inside the widget. When enabled, shoppers can submit questions, and answers appear beneath the relevant product. Q&A works best when you answer quickly. Even a short, clear answer can prevent abandoned carts caused by uncertainty. Best practices Keep the rating summary visible: Make sure the average rating layout is easy to spot so shoppers can quickly judge product quality. Choose a readable layout: Use List layout if your reviews are long, or Grid layout if you want a compact look. Balance page length with detail: Set a reasonable Reviews Per Page so the page doesn’t feel endless, especially on mobile. Use “Most Recent” for social proof: Recent reviews reassure shoppers that feedback is current. Troubleshooting Confirm the widget is installed under Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Product Review. Check that you’re viewing a live product page (not a password page or a product that isn’t published). If the product has no reviews yet, confirm whether your widget settings show an empty state or hide the widget until reviews exist. If your theme uses a custom product template, the widget placement may differ from standard themes. Try switching between Grid and List layout. If using grid, reduce Columns Per Row to prevent tight spacing. Lower Reviews Per Page to improve page readability and loading on long review threads. Photos only appear on reviews where customers uploaded images. Verified buyer badges display only when your settings and order verification rules support them.

pages.title: Popup Review Widget – Show Real Customer Reviews as Popups • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Popup Review Widget shows real customer reviews as small popup notifications on your storefront. These popups appear while visitors browse your store, highlighting positive feedback and building trust. Increase customer confidence by showing social proof while shoppers browse Showcase real customer experiences without sending visitors away from the page Improve conversion rates by reinforcing product quality at the right time Highlight featured reviews you’ve selected as your best Popups can display the product image, review content, customer name, rating, and optional badges (like Verified Purchase), depending on your settings. For the best results, use popups on product and collection pages where shoppers are actively comparing options. Keep the popup content short and the display frequency moderate so it feels helpful—not distracting. How the Popup Review Widget works Once enabled, Rivyo automatically displays reviews as small popup notifications across your storefront. Appear after a defined delay (so they don’t show immediately on page load) Rotate through selected reviews based on your “Reviews to display” choice Display one review at a time to keep the message easy to read Automatically disappear after a few seconds The Popup Review Widget is designed to be “set and forget.” After you choose what to show and how it looks, it runs automatically in the background. Enable the Popup Review Widget Use the steps below to turn on popup reviews. In your Rivyo admin, go to: Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Popup Review Widget Turn on: Enable Popup Reviews Once enabled, Rivyo will start displaying review popups on your storefront using your current settings. Choose which reviews to display Decide which reviews Rivyo is allowed to show in popups. This is the most important setting for keeping the popups high-quality and relevant. Reviews to display Featured Reviews – Only reviews you’ve marked as featured Recent Reviews – The latest reviews submitted to your store All Reviews – Any available review can appear Most merchants choose Featured Reviews so popups consistently show your strongest, most helpful feedback. If you choose Recent Reviews, check reviews regularly to ensure new popups match your brand tone. Configure popup rotation Reviews in rotation Choose how many reviews Rivyo rotates through in the popup system. Maximum: 20 reviews Example: If you select 10, Rivyo will rotate through those 10 reviews. A smaller rotation (for example, 6–10) keeps the message consistent and reduces the chance of showing an outdated or less relevant review. Set popup position Choose where the popup appears on the screen. Common options include: Bottom Right Bottom Left Top Right Top Left Most stores use Bottom Right because it’s noticeable without covering key page elements like navigation, product media, or add-to-cart buttons. If you use sticky carts, chat widgets, or cookie banners, test placement to avoid overlapping important buttons—especially on mobile. Display options Control what information appears inside each popup. These settings affect how trustworthy and “busy” the popup feels. Show Verified Badge Shows a Verified Purchase badge (when available) to reinforce authenticity. Show Product Image Displays the product image next to the review. This helps shoppers connect the review to a specific item at a glance. Show customer name Displays the reviewer’s name (or the name format you’ve collected). Names can increase credibility, but if your store collects initials only, this still works well. Show rating Displays the star rating in the popup so shoppers immediately understand the sentiment before reading. Show review text Shows the review content. If your reviews are long, consider enabling popups with shorter featured reviews to keep popups readable. A balanced “high trust, low clutter” popup usually includes: Product image, Star rating, and Short review text. Add the Verified Badge if your store has many verified orders. Recommended settings (best practice) If you want popups that build trust without interrupting shopping, start with these defaults: Reviews to display: Featured Reviews Reviews in rotation: 6–10 Position: Bottom Right Content: Product image + star rating + short text (and Verified badge if available) After enabling, watch your storefront for a few minutes to confirm placement, readability, and that the popups don’t cover key UI elements (especially on mobile). FAQ Confirm Enable Popup Reviews is turned on in Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Popup Review Widget. Make sure you have eligible reviews for your selection (for example, if you chose Featured Reviews, at least one review must be featured). Wait long enough for the popup delay and rotation to trigger (popups do not always appear immediately on page load). Check for overlap with theme elements (chat widgets, cookie banners) and try a different popup position. Featured Reviews is best for consistent quality and brand control. Recent Reviews is best if you frequently receive new reviews and want the storefront to feel “live.” All Reviews is best if you have a strong overall review profile and want maximum variety. Popups are designed to be lightweight. Keep the rotation count reasonable (for example, under 10) and avoid overly busy display settings if your theme already has multiple overlays or scripts running. Use Bottom Right placement. Limit Reviews in rotation to a smaller set of high-quality reviews. Show concise content (short featured reviews). Avoid covering key actions (Add to cart, checkout, chat). What to do next Mark reviews as Featured so your popups consistently highlight your strongest social proof. Adjust styling across your widgets to match your theme (colors, typography, and layout). Increase your review volume so you have more high-quality options to rotate through.

pages.title: Review Carousel Widget – Display Customer Reviews in a Carousel • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Review Carousel Widget lets you showcase customer reviews in a horizontal, swipeable slider (carousel) on your storefront. Instead of displaying reviews in a long list, the carousel rotates through review cards—making it ideal for highlighting social proof on high-traffic pages like your homepage, product pages, and landing pages. The carousel can display: Text reviews Photo reviews Video reviews Featured reviews (hand-picked highlights) For the best conversion impact, place a Review Carousel near a key decision point—like below your hero section on the homepage or near the “Add to cart” section on a product page. Add the Review Carousel to your storefront In your app admin, go to Widgets (or Storefront) and select Review Carousel. Select the page or placement where you want the carousel to show (for example: Homepage, Product page, or a Landing page). Choose what reviews to show, how the carousel behaves, and how the cards look (details below). Use the preview to confirm spacing, readability, and how many cards show on desktop vs mobile, then Publish your changes. The exact menu names can vary depending on your theme/editor. If you don’t see “Widgets,” look for sections like Storefront, Onsite display, or Theme integration. What you can display in the carousel Review type Choose which reviews the carousel can pull from: All Reviews — Displays all available reviews (based on your store’s review visibility rules). Featured Reviews — Displays only reviews you’ve marked as featured. Use Featured Reviews for homepage and paid-traffic landing pages so you control the story: pick reviews that mention your best-selling products, fast shipping, fit/quality, or customer service. Review media type Filter reviews by the type of media they include: All Media — Shows all reviews (text-only, photos, and videos). Only Image — Shows only reviews that include at least one photo. Only Video — Shows only reviews that include a video. Media-only filters are a great fit for brand storytelling sections (for example: “Customer photos”) and for mobile-first pages where visuals outperform long text. Carousel heading (title and summary) Add a heading above the carousel to set context and increase trust. Example heading: Real customer stories Heading customization options Heading text — The title shown above the carousel. Text alignment — Typically left, center, or right (depending on your theme layout). Text color — Ensure strong contrast with the page background. Title size — Adjust to match your storefront typography scale. Optional trust signals You can also show supporting details near the heading, such as: Star rating summary (average rating) Total review count Verified badge (when available for the review/source) If you show total review count, keep it consistent across pages (homepage, product pages, and dedicated reviews page) to avoid confusing shoppers. Carousel behavior settings Control how shoppers interact with the carousel and how many reviews they see at once. Navigation arrows Enable Navigation arrows so visitors can manually move through reviews. Arrows are especially helpful on desktop where swipe gestures are less common. Auto scroll Enable Auto Scroll to automatically rotate reviews. This draws attention to the widget, especially when placed above the fold. If your carousel is placed near other moving elements (videos, animated banners, or multiple sliders), consider turning Auto Scroll off to reduce distraction and improve readability. Reviews per row Choose how many review cards appear at the same time: 1 review — Best for mobile-first layouts and longer review text. 2 reviews — Balanced option for most pages. 3 reviews — Good for short reviews and wider layouts. 4 reviews — Best when reviews are short and you want a “wall of social proof” effect. If reviews include photos or long text, start with 2 per row. Too many cards at once can make text hard to read and reduce engagement. Space between cards Adjust the spacing to match your theme’s grid. Use tighter spacing for a compact section; increase spacing if the page feels crowded or the cards blend into the background. Card appearance settings Customize the look of each review card so it feels native to your storefront design. Card background color Choose a background color that keeps the review text readable and visually separates cards from the page background (especially on white or very dark pages). Card outline (border) Enable or disable a border around review cards. Borders can help cards stand out on busy pages or when your page background is similar to the card background. If your theme already uses “card” styling across the site, match the carousel card background and border style to maintain a consistent look. Recommended setups Review type: Featured Reviews Media type: All Media Reviews per row: 2–3 Auto scroll: On (if the page isn’t already animation-heavy) Heading: Include star rating summary + total review count Review type: All Reviews (or Featured if you want tight control) Media type: Only Image (great for apparel/beauty/home) Reviews per row: 1–2 Auto scroll: Off (so shoppers can read at their pace) Placement: Near key product details (shipping/returns/size info) Review type: Featured Reviews (curate to match the ad’s promise) Media type: Only Video or Only Image (if available) Reviews per row: 2 Card styling: Higher contrast (clear background + subtle border) Troubleshooting Confirm you have reviews available and visible (for example, not all are hidden/unpublished). If Featured Reviews is selected, make sure at least one review is marked as featured. If Only Image or Only Video is selected, confirm you have reviews that include that media type. Increase card background contrast (lighter background on dark pages, or slightly tinted background on white pages). Turn on a card outline to separate cards from the page. Reduce reviews per row so each card has more space. Turn Auto Scroll off and rely on navigation arrows. Show fewer cards at once (for example, change from 4 to 2) so shoppers can focus on one review. Move the carousel lower on the page if it competes with key messages in your hero section.

pages.title: Store Average Rating Widget – Display Your Store’s Overall Rating • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text:
OverviewThe Store Average Rating widget highlights your store’s overall rating based on customer store reviews. It helps shoppers quickly understand your reputation and builds trust before they browse products.What the widget showsAverage store rating (for example, 4.9)Total number of store reviews (for example, 79 reviews)Star visualization that matches the average ratingExample⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ Customers rate us 4.9 based on 79 reviewsPlace this widget near high-visibility areas (top of homepage, above the fold, or near “Add to cart” paths) to reinforce trust early.Where the widget can appearYou can display the Store Average Rating widget on any page where you want to reinforce credibility, such as:HomepageAbout Us pageLanding pages (campaign pages, influencer pages, etc.)Footer sectionsDedicated review pagesIf you add the widget in a shared section (like the footer), it may appear across multiple pages depending on your theme setup.Install the Store Average Rating widgetThere are two ways to add the widget to your storefront. Use the Shopify Theme Editor method if your theme supports app blocks.Method 1: Add using Shopify Theme Editor (recommended)This method is best for Online Store 2.0 themes and does not require editing theme code.In Shopify Admin, go to Online Store → Themes, then click Customize on your active theme.Use the page selector (top bar in the theme editor) to open the page/template where you want the widget to appear (for example: Home page, a specific page template, or a section like the footer).Click Add block (or Add section, depending on your theme), then select Store Average Rating from the Rivyo app blocks.Drag the block to the desired position, preview how it looks, and click Save.Method 2: Manual installation (older themes)If your theme does not support app blocks, you can install the widget by adding a small embed snippet where you want it to display.In the Rivyo app, go to Reviews → Widget Styling → Store Average Rating.Copy the provided snippet:
Paste the snippet into the theme template or page content where you want the widget to appear, then save your changes.Manual installation edits your theme code. If you’re not comfortable making theme changes, use the Theme Editor method or ask your theme developer for help. A small mistake in theme files can affect storefront layout.Customize the Store Average Rating widgetYou can customize the message shown next to the stars (for example: “Customers rate us 4.9 based on 79 reviews”).Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Styling → Store Average Rating.Update the text template to match your brand voice. Example:Customers rate us {{%average%}} based on {{%rating%}} reviews.Save your changes, then refresh your storefront page to confirm the updated text appears as expected.Text variables you can useUse the variables below to automatically display live values in your message:VariableWhat it displays{{%average%}}The current average store rating{{%rating%}}The total number of store reviewsKeep the message short and easy to scan. Shoppers should understand it in a glance—especially on mobile.TroubleshootingConfirm you added the Store Average Rating block on the correct page/template in the Theme Editor.If you installed manually, confirm the snippet is placed in a visible section (not inside commented code or hidden containers).Clear any storefront cache and refresh the page (try an incognito/private window).The widget reflects your store reviews (not product reviews).If you recently received new reviews, refresh the page and allow a short time for the storefront to update.Use Method 2: Manual installation, or consider upgrading to an Online Store 2.0 theme for easier widget placement and future updates.

pages.title: Testimonials Widget – Showcase Featured Customer Reviews • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview The Testimonials Widget lets you highlight your best customer reviews in a clean, testimonial-style section on your storefront. Instead of showing reviews in a long list, it features selected reviews in a more polished layout—great for building trust and helping shoppers feel confident before they buy. Use the Testimonials widget on high-traffic pages like your homepage, collection pages, or your best-selling product pages to maximize impact. Install the Testimonials widget in your theme To show testimonials on your storefront, you need to add the widget block to the page in your Shopify theme editor. In Shopify, go to Online Store → Themes, then click Customize on your current theme. In the left sidebar, click Add section or select the section where you want testimonials to appear, then click Add block. From the block list, choose Testimonials Carousel. Add the Testimonials Carousel to pages where customers are deciding to buy (home page, best-selling product pages, or a featured collection page). One strong testimonial in the right spot can increase confidence quickly. How the Testimonials widget works The Testimonials widget shows featured reviews only. If a review isn’t marked as featured, it won’t appear in this widget. Feature reviews to display in the widget Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Product Reviews. Select the review you want to display as a testimonial. Enable or click the Featured option for that review. Once it’s featured, the review becomes eligible to show in the Testimonials widget (depending on your widget settings and layout). You can feature and show: Product reviews Store reviews If you’ve featured reviews but don’t see them on your storefront, confirm the Testimonials Carousel block is added to the correct page/section in your theme, and that the block (or section) isn’t hidden by page-specific settings. Customize the testimonial section title You can add a heading above your testimonials to match your store’s tone and layout. Example title: What Customers Are Saying Title customization options Title text Title alignment (Left, Center, Right) Text color Text size Keep the title short and benefit-focused. Examples: “Loved by Customers”, “Real Reviews”, or “Why Shoppers Trust Us”. Layout options Choose a layout based on how many testimonials you want visible at once and how much space you have on the page. Slider – Shows testimonials one at a time (or in a rotating set), switching automatically or via navigation. Grid – Displays multiple testimonials at once in a tiled layout. Many stores use the Slider layout to spotlight one strong testimonial at a time, especially on the homepage. Customize the design After adding the Testimonials Carousel block in your theme editor, use the block settings to match your storefront style. Common design settings include: Card style (spacing, borders, rounded corners) Text styling (font size and colors for review text, reviewer name, and rating) Background color (for the section or testimonial cards) Rating display (show/hide stars if available in your theme/widget settings) Slider controls (show/hide arrows or dots, autoplay when available) If your testimonials look different than expected, double-check that you’re editing the correct theme and the correct template (for example, Home page vs Default product template). Troubleshooting Make sure you’ve marked at least one review as Featured. Confirm the Testimonials Carousel block is added to the page you’re viewing. In the theme editor, verify the section/block is not hidden (visibility settings can vary by theme). Check whether you’re featuring the correct type of review (product vs store), based on what your widget is set up to display. Save changes in your theme editor, then refresh the storefront page (hard refresh if needed). The Testimonials widget displays featured reviews. Review which items are currently marked as Featured and remove the Featured flag from any reviews you don’t want to highlight.

pages.title: Product Q&A Widget – Enable Customer Questions on Product Pages • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: OverviewThe Product Q&A Widget lets shoppers ask questions about a product directly on the product page. You (the store owner) can answer from Rivyo, and the question + answer can be displayed publicly so future shoppers can learn from it.Reduce pre-purchase support by answering common questions onceIncrease conversion by removing uncertainty at the point of purchaseBuild trust with transparent, helpful answersCreate a product knowledge base that grows over timeProduct Q&A works especially well for products where shoppers often ask about sizing, compatibility, materials, delivery timelines, or what’s included in the box.How Product Q&A worksCustomers submit a question on the product page.You receive the question in Rivyo.You reply from the Rivyo dashboard.The question and your answer appear on the product page (so other shoppers can benefit).Your theme controls where the widget appears based on where you add the block in the Shopify Theme Editor.Choose how Q&A appears on your product pageYou can show Q&A in one of two ways:Option 1: Add a dedicated Product Q&A sectionThis creates a separate Questions & Answers area on the product page (typically below the product details). It’s best when you want Q&A to be easy to notice and browse.Install the Product Q&A widgetIn Shopify admin, open Rivyo, then go to: Reviews → Widgets → Product Question and AnswerSelect Add Product Q&A Widget.You’ll be redirected to the Shopify Theme Editor. Click Add block in your product template.Search for: Rivyo: Product Q&ADrag the block to the right position in your product page layout (commonly below product description or below reviews).Click Save in the Theme Editor. Your product pages will now show a Questions & Answers section.If your product template has multiple sections (for example, separate areas for description, reviews, and FAQs), place the Q&A block near the content customers read before purchasing.Option 2: Allow questions inside the Reviews sectionInstead of a separate Q&A section, you can let customers ask questions from the reviews area. In this setup, an Ask a Question button appears near your reviews, keeping Q&A and reviews together.Enable “Ask a Question” in ReviewsGo to: Rivyo → Reviews → Widgets → Product Question and AnswerTurn on Enable Ask a Question in Reviews.Click Save. Customers will now see an Ask a Question button next to your reviews.This option is ideal if your store already gets strong engagement in reviews and you want to keep product discussions in one place.Managing customer questionsAfter customers start submitting questions, you can manage them from Rivyo—review new questions, reply, and keep responses clear and helpful.In Rivyo, go to the Product Question and Answer section (the same area where you enabled/installed the widget).Look for newly submitted questions and open each one to see the product it was asked on and the customer’s message.Write an answer that helps someone decide whether to buy: include exact measurements, compatibility details, what’s included, care instructions, or timelines.Visit the product page in your storefront and confirm the question and answer display correctly in the section where you added Q&A.Treat answers like mini product documentation. When possible, include concrete details (sizes, materials, model numbers, “works with/doesn’t work with”, and what comes in the package).Best practices for higher-quality Q&AAnswer fast: timely responses keep shoppers from leaving to find info elsewhere.Be consistent: use the same terms as your product page (size names, variants, bundles).Prevent repeat questions: if a question comes up repeatedly, add the answer to your product description or FAQ section too.Keep it shopper-friendly: avoid internal codes; use plain language and real examples.Handle sensitive requests carefully: don’t share private order/customer details in public answers.Don’t include personal customer information (email, phone, address, order numbers) in Q&A responses. Q&A is meant to be public and searchable by future shoppers.TroubleshootingConfirm you clicked Save in the Shopify Theme Editor after adding the block.Make sure you added the block to the product template (not a different page template).If your theme has multiple product templates, confirm you edited the one used by the product you’re testing.Reload the storefront in an incognito/private window to avoid cached theme changes.Test on the storefront yourself (desktop + mobile) to confirm the form opens and submits.Temporarily disable conflicting theme apps that inject popup/modals if the Q&A form is blocked.Check that the widget is enabled in Rivyo → Reviews → Widgets → Product Question and Answer.Open the Shopify Theme Editor and drag the Rivyo: Product Q&A block higher/lower in the product layout, then click Save.Choose the display that matches your store layout:Separate section: add the Rivyo: Product Q&A block to your product template.Inside reviews: enable Ask a Question in Reviews in the Product Q&A settings.What customers seeA place to ask product-specific questions on the product page (either as a dedicated section or from the reviews area).Public answers from your store that help them decide before purchasing.Previously answered questions, so they can find info without contacting support.Once Q&A is live, consider adding 2–3 starter questions (based on your most common support tickets) and answering them. This “seeds” the section and increases shopper engagement.

pages.title: Enable Social Sharing for Product/Store Reviews • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: OverviewSocial Sharing lets shoppers share individual reviews from your store to popular channels—turning real customer feedback into social proof that can bring new visitors back to your products.When enabled, customers can share reviews using:FacebookX (Twitter)WhatsAppEmailSocial Sharing only appears on your storefront after you (1) add/enable platforms in Settings → Social Share and (2) turn on Social Sharing inside the widget(s) where you want it to show.Supported widgetsProduct Review WidgetAll Product Reviews WidgetStore Reviews WidgetHow Social Sharing worksYou add the social platforms you want to offer in Settings → Social Share.You enable the platforms you want to show to customers.You enable Social Sharing in the widget customization settings for the widget(s) on your store.Customers see social icons next to reviews on your storefront.When a customer clicks an icon, a share window opens for that platform with a pre-filled share link.Keep your share options focused. Fewer, more relevant platforms usually leads to more clicks than showing every possible option.Add social media platformsAdd the platforms where customers will be able to share reviews. You can create your own list (for example, add WhatsApp and Email, and remove platforms you don’t use).Go to Rivyo → Reviews → Widget Stlying, then open General Settings and select the Social Share tab.Click Add Social Share.Platform Name: Enter the display name customers will recognize (example: Facebook, X, WhatsApp).Platform Link: Paste the platform’s share URL (the link Rivyo uses to open the share dialog).Platform Icon (SVG): Paste the SVG code for the icon that appears next to each review.Click Add to save the platform.Use SVG icons from trusted sources only. Pasting untrusted code into an SVG field can create security and display issues.Enable or disable social platformsEach platform you add has a status toggle. This controls whether the platform appears as a sharing option on your storefront.Enable: Customers can use this platform to share reviews.Disable: The platform is hidden and will not appear in any widget.Disabling a platform does not delete it—you can re-enable it anytime.Maximum platforms allowedYou can add up to 5 social media platforms for social sharing.This limit keeps the review UI clean and prevents the share area from taking over the review layout on smaller screens.Enable Social Sharing in review widgetsAdding platforms in Settings → Social Share does not automatically show them on your storefront. You must also enable Social Sharing inside the widget(s) where you want the icons to appear.Go to Rivyo → Reviews and open the widget customization area for the widget you use on your store (for example, Product Review Widget).Find the Social Sharing option in the widget settings and set it to Enabled.Save your changes. Then refresh your storefront page to confirm the share icons appear next to reviews.If you use multiple widgets (for example, a Product Review Widget on product pages and an All Product Reviews Widget on a reviews page), enable Social Sharing in each widget separately.What customers see on your storeShare icons appear alongside reviews (based on your widget layout).Only the platforms you enabled are shown.Clicking an icon opens that platform’s sharing flow (for example, a new window/tab or the user’s email app).TroubleshootingConfirm the platform is Enabled in Settings → Social Share.Confirm Social Sharing is enabled in the specific widget you’re using (Product Review / All Reviews / Store Reviews).Refresh your storefront and clear any caching (theme/app caches can delay visual changes).Check the Platform Link you entered. An incorrect share URL can prevent the share dialog from opening.Try in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extension pop-up blockers.If the platform opens in a new window/tab, confirm the browser is not blocking pop-ups for your domain.Replace the SVG with a clean, single-color SVG (simple paths tend to render best in widgets).Avoid SVGs with embedded images or heavy filters—these may not scale well.Social Sharing is designed to be fast and easy for shoppers. Too many share buttons can clutter the review layout, especially on mobile. Pick the 3–5 channels your customers use most.Best practicesStart with your top channels: Most stores see the best results with 2–4 highly relevant platforms.Use recognizable names and icons: Customers are more likely to share when options are instantly familiar.Check mobile display: Review pages are often browsed on mobile—confirm icons don’t wrap awkwardly.Enable sharing where it matters: Product pages and “All Reviews” pages are usually the highest-impact locations.

pages.title: Export Product and Store Reviews from Rivyo • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Rivyo lets you export your reviews to a CSV file so you can save a copy, share results, run reports, or move review data to another system. You can export: Product reviews (reviews left on individual product pages) Store reviews (reviews about the overall store experience) Your export downloads to your computer and can be opened in tools like Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or Apple Numbers. Exporting reviews regularly is a simple way to keep an offline backup of customer feedback. What’s included in the export Rivyo generates a CSV file that contains your review data in rows and columns. Depending on the review type and what your customers submitted, your file can include: Product name (for product reviews) Customer name (if collected) Review title Review content Rating Review date Review status (for example, approved/pending) Media links (when photos/videos were attached) CSV files store data as plain text. If you see long numbers, dates, or special characters formatted oddly in Excel, try opening the file in Google Sheets (or use Excel’s import option) to control formatting. How exporting reviews works When you run an export, Rivyo creates a CSV file from your current review records and downloads it to your device. You can then: Filter and sort reviews (by rating, date, status, etc.) Build reports (average rating trends, volume by product, common keywords) Share a snapshot of review feedback with your team Migrate review data to another tool that accepts CSV How to export reviews In your Shopify admin, go to Rivyo → Reviews. Click Export Reviews. Select the review type you want to export (Product Reviews or Store Reviews). Click Download CSV. The file will download to your computer. Select a review type Product Reviews Exports reviews submitted on individual product pages. This typically includes: Product name Product rating Review title and comments Customer information (when available) Uploaded media links (when available) Reviews imported from marketplaces (such as Amazon or AliExpress) may not be included in exports in some cases. If you don’t see expected imported reviews in the CSV, compare your import source and the reviews shown in Rivyo. Store Reviews Exports reviews submitted for your overall store (not tied to a specific product). Store reviews usually reflect the full shopping experience (for example, shipping, support, and overall satisfaction). Export file format (CSV) Your download is a .csv file, which works well for spreadsheets and reporting tools. One row usually represents one review. Columns represent review details (rating, date, content, status, and so on). Media is commonly provided as a link when available. If you plan to import the CSV into another system, confirm that system’s required column names and formats first. You may need to rename columns or adjust date formats in your spreadsheet. Best practices Export on a schedule (weekly or monthly) if you rely on review reporting. Keep an “original” copy of the export before editing it, so you can always return to the raw data. Store files securely if your export includes customer-identifying information. Track changes over time by saving exports with a clear filename (for example, reviews-export-2026-03-13.csv). Troubleshooting Try one of the following: Open the file with Google Sheets (it often handles CSV encoding cleanly). In Excel, use Data → From Text/CSV to import the file and choose the correct delimiter/encoding. Check these common causes: You exported the wrong review type (Product vs Store). The reviews were imported from a marketplace source that may not be included in exports in certain cases. You’re comparing against filtered views in the app—ensure you’re reviewing all reviews when verifying totals. If a review includes photos or videos, the export typically lists them as media links (when available). You can paste these links into a browser to view the media.

pages.title: Import Reviews into Rivyo • Reviews • Rivyo Help Center – Reviews, Loyalty & Referral Program Setup Guides for Shopify
pages.text: Overview Importing reviews helps you build social proof quickly—without waiting weeks to collect new feedback from scratch. If you’re switching from another Shopify reviews app, already have reviews in a spreadsheet, or sell products that have reviews on marketplaces, Rivyo lets you bring those reviews into your store in a few guided steps. You can import two kinds of reviews: Product reviews — tied to a specific Shopify product (shown on product pages) Store reviews — about the overall shopping experience (often shown in a site-wide widget) Imported reviews behave like normal reviews in Rivyo: you can approve/unapprove them, edit them, and display them on your storefront based on your widget and display settings. Before you start Decide what you’re importing: product reviews, store reviews, or both. (Many stores import product reviews first, then store reviews.) Make sure you can match reviews to products if you’re importing product reviews. The most reliable match is a Shopify Product Handle or Product ID. Plan your approval workflow: choose whether imported reviews should go live immediately or be reviewed first. If you’re unsure how your file is formatted, start with a small test import (10–20 reviews). Confirm they appear on the correct products, then import the full file. Types of review imports supported Rivyo supports multiple import methods so you can use the source that fits your situation. 1) Import reviews using a CSV file Upload a CSV file to import either product reviews or store reviews. This option is best when: You exported reviews from another platform or tool You collected reviews manually (e.g., from email, support tickets, in-store feedback) You want to bulk upload reviews on a schedule CSV imports commonly include fields like: Product ID or Product Handle (for product reviews) Customer name Email (optional for display; helpful for internal records) Rating (for example, 1–5) Review content Review date During import, you can typically choose options such as: Auto-approve imported reviews (publishes them immediately) Keep imported reviews pending (lets you review before publishing) Skip duplicates (prevents the same review from being added more than once) Ensure each row is one review. For product reviews, include a product identifier (recommended: Product Handle). Keep ratings consistent (for example, all ratings as numbers). In Rivyo, go to the Import Reviews area and select CSV Import. Choose whether you’re importing Product or Store reviews. Match the CSV columns to Rivyo fields (rating, review content, date, product identifier, etc.). Select whether reviews should be auto-approved and whether to skip duplicates. If available, run a small test import first. After confirming the results, complete the full import. Check a few products on your storefront and confirm the reviews appear in the correct location and format. If you imported as pending, approve reviews when you’re ready to publish. Incorrect product matching is the most common import issue. If reviews appear on the wrong product (or not at all), review your product identifier column (Handle/ID) and re-import after correcting the file. 2) Import reviews from other Shopify review apps If you previously used another Shopify reviews app, Rivyo can migrate your existing reviews so you don’t lose your history when switching. In most cases, you download an export from your old app and upload it into Rivyo. Commonly supported sources include: Judge.me Loox Yotpo Stamped.io Rivyo will typically detect and map the exported fields (ratings, content, reviewer name, product mapping) so you don’t have to build a CSV from scratch. In your previous reviews app, export your reviews file (usually CSV). Save it to your computer. In Rivyo’s Import Reviews area, select the importer for your previous app (for example, Judge.me or Loox). Upload the export file and review how fields are mapped—especially product matching and review dates. Complete the import, then spot-check a few products to confirm reviews appear correctly. If you’re migrating from another app, import once (and only once) after your final export—then avoid running additional exports/imports, which can introduce duplicates. 3) Import reviews from AliExpress If your products are sourced from AliExpress, you can import reviews directly from AliExpress product pages to quickly build credibility on your Shopify product pages. With the AliExpress importer, you can typically: Open an AliExpress product page Use the Rivyo AliExpress importer Import selected reviews into a matching Shopify product Go to the AliExpress product page that contains the reviews you want to use. Open Rivyo’s AliExpress importer and follow the prompts to capture reviews from the page. Select the Shopify product the reviews should be attached to, then import. Only import reviews you have the right to use, and avoid importing reviews that include personal data you shouldn’t publish. Keep your imports aligned with your store policies and local regulations. 4) Import reviews from Amazon You can also import Amazon product reviews using the Rivyo Chrome extension. This is helpful if your products have an established review history on Amazon and you want to bring that social proof to your Shopify store. This method generally works like this: You open an Amazon product page in Chrome You use the Rivyo extension to collect reviews from that page You import them into Rivyo and attach them to the correct Shopify product Install the extension in Google Chrome, then confirm it’s enabled. Navigate to the Amazon listing that contains the reviews you want to import. Use the extension to select and collect reviews. If options are available, choose the review range, rating filters, or sorting that fits your needs. In Rivyo, select the Shopify product that should receive the imported reviews, then complete the import. Amazon pages can vary by region and layout, which may affect what the extension can capture. If an import doesn’t pull the expected reviews, try a different product page variant (for example, a different locale) or reduce the amount you’re importing at once. After you import: recommended checks Confirm product matching: open a few products and verify imported reviews appear on the correct product page.
